༄༅/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa yo ga chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgya gar skad du

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa yo ga chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ sa de ba dza gaṅgu ru bha dra bhaṭ+ṭa ra ka tsakra na tha gu ru tri tsa bha ga wan bai ro tsā na pa de ma mi dai ha wan+ma ti bhikā ban+da na kram̐ tam̐/ bod skad du/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba'i bla ma rje btsun 'khor lo'i mgon po bla ma gsum dang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad zhabs la bdag lus ngag yid gsum gus pas 'dud par bgyi'o/ /gang la gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don mdzad sprul pa'i sku/ /kun khyab srid dang zhi ba'i bdag po rdo rje sems/ /de dang dbyer med bdag la bka' drin mnyam med pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs mched dang rje btsun mus pa chen po rgyal/ /rgyud rgyal smra ba'i dbang phyug bsdu par byed po dang / /de nyid 'phags yul rgyas mdzad slob dpon rnam pa gsum/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir lha yi skad las bsgyur mdzad pa'i/ /bka' drin mnyam med lo chen mchog rnams phyag gi gnas/ /kha ba ri ba'i bsod nams zhing du legs byon pa'i/ /phyi dar bstan pa'i gsal byed kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /sa skya'i bla chen yab sras brgyud par bcas rnams dang / /gang gi bstan 'dzin mkhas grub rim par byon la 'dud/ /khyad par snyigs dus bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog /sngags 'chang bla ma kun dga' rin chen zhes/ /ci mdzad bstan dang 'gro ba'i don gyur pa'i/ /ngo mtshar sprul pa'i zlos gar khyod gcig bsngags/ /bdag kyang skyes chen khyed sku ci 'dra ba'i/ /sku tshe tshad dang 'gro la gzhan phan dang / /thugs sras bskrun tshul bstan pa'i rgyun la sogs/ /de 'dra kho nar 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /dang 'dod yid ches dad pas dge legs kyi/ /tshig gi mchod brjod 'dod don gsol btab nas/ /sngon med ngo mtshar legs bshad 'chad la spro/

/rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam chos byung ba'i tshul/ /ha cang rgyas dang bsdus min 'tshams pa'i ngag /yo ga chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed 'di/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir 'dir spel lo/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa dang rtsom par dam bca' ba'i tshig sngon du btang nas/ 'dir rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa yo ga chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di 'chad pa la/ spyi don rnam pa bzhi ste/ rnal 'byor rgyud ston pas ji ltar gsungs shing bsdu pa pos ji ltar bsdus pa'i tshul/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sgra don dang dbye ba bstan pa/ rnal 'byor rgyud 'di mi yul du dus nam byung ba'i tshul/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lam srol ji ltar dar ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ spyir bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de nyid kyis gdul bya sna tshogs pa'i don du/ chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs kyang / bsdu na rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang / 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su 'dus te/ mdo sde gdams ngag 'bog pa'i rgyal po las/ 'dren pas theg pa gsum po dag /bcom ldan nges par gsungs lags na/ /rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu spyod cing / /sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba'i/ /nges pa'i theg pa cis ma gsungs/ /zhes zhus pa dang / rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar gnyis kyi nang nas 'dir phyi ma ste/ de la yang rgya bod kyi paṇa grub so so'i bzhed pa'i rgyud sde'i dbye sgo gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang / drug tu dbye ba la sogs pa mang du yod pa'i nang nas/ 'dir slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes sngags don rnams gzigs pas/

rnal 'byor spyod dang bya dbye bas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsum du gsungs pa'i phyi ma rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul te/ de yang 'o na rgyud 'di thog mar ston pas gsungs pa'i tshul ji ltar snyam na/ ston pa 'dis dang por byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ mthar 'og min chen por mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bskor ba yin zhing / khyad par rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsungs tshul ni/ ston pa rnam par snang mdzad gnas 'og min lha'i rgyal po'i gzhal yas khang na byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor du mas bskor ba na rtsa ba'i rgyud de nyid bcu'i bdag nyid 'dus pa dum bu bzhi pa dang / glegs bam de nyid dang 'brel ba'i rgyud phyi ma dang / phyi ma'i phyi ma rnams gsungs so/ /de nas slar yang sprul bshad mdzad tshul ni/ longs sku rnam snang 'og min gyi gnas las bskyod par mi mdzad pas/ rnam snang sprul sku ri rab kyi rtse mo khang brtsegs rdo rje rin po che las byas par byon nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du byin gyis brlabs te/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus seng ge'i gdan du sprul pa la zhal bzhi par bstan te bzhugs shing / phyogs bzhir mi bskyod pa la sogs pa bzhi yang so so nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du bdag nyid kyis byin brlabs te/ glang po che la sogs pa'i gdan gyi steng du bzhugs so/ /de nas rnam snang gis sems dpa' bcu drug sgo bdun bdun gyis sprul/ mi bskyod pa la sogs pa bzhis sems ma rdo rje ma la sogs pa bzhi dang / yang rnam snang gis sgeg mo la sogs pa bzhi dang / mi bskyod pa la sogs pa bzhis bdug pa ma la sogs pa bzhi dang / yang rnam snang gis lcags kyu la sogs bzhi sprul te/

rnam snang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bsdus nas/ de rnams kyis sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la mchod brjod byas te/ de thams cad rnam snang gi thugs khar bzhugs te/ de nas thugs kha nas de bzhin gshegs pa rang rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa byung nas sprul pa rnams la thim ste mchod brjod mdzad/ de nas rnam snang dang rnam snang chen po thob pa'i thabs ting nge 'dzin gsum bstan nas/ thabs de la 'jug pa'i rgyur dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'i cho ga dgos pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus nas rdo rje sems dpa' la mtshan brgya rtsas bstod nas/ dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa yis/ /cho ga mchog ni bshad par gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdor sems kyi ting nge 'dzin sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas slob dpon gyi las dang / dkyil 'khor thams cad du 'jug pa'i cho ga dang / dngos grub kyi ye shes dang / phyag rgya'i ye shes la sogs pa nas phyag rgya bkrol ba'i bar gyi rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga rgyas par gsungs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis lha mo sum cu rtsa bdun spros mdzad pa rnams mdzad/ phyag mtshan gyi gzugs su gyur nas dkyil 'khor la bkod de/ gzungs dkyil sprul nas brtan par bya ba'i phyir rigs lngas gtso mo lnga'i rig pa dang / rdor sems kyis lha lhag ma rnams kyi rig pa gsungs nas dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gsungs shing / gzungs dkyil gyi cho ga bstan/ de nas rigs lngas rang rang gi snying po dang / rnam snang gi chos dkyil sprul nas/ rdor sems kyi chos dkyil gyi bshad pa gsungs/ de nas rigs lngas rang rang gi chos dkyil rten byed kyi ting nge 'dzin la zhugs nas rang rang gi sngags gsungs shing rnam snang gis lha mo rnams sprul nas gnas su bkod ched du brjod do/ /de nas rdor sems kyis chos dkyil gyi bshad pa gsungs so/

/de nas bar ma la dga' ba'i don du rigs bsdus pa phyag rgya bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang / bsdus pa la dga' ba'i don du phyag rgya gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam snang gis sprul nas rdor sems kyis de dag gi cho ga la sogs pa bshad de de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud/ sbyang gzhi sems can gyi lus dang gti mug gi gnyen por rnam snang gtso bor gyur pa'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor ston pa dum bu dang po gsungs la/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgongs pa gcig tu bsdus nas rdor sems la mtshan brgyas bstod de rgyud gsung bar gsol ba btab pas/ rdor sems kyis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ma 'tshal to/ /zhes gsungs/ ci'i phyir ma 'tshal zhes/ bka' stsal pa dang / dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa ma rung pa rnams sangs rgyas kyis kyang zhi bas ma thul ba bdag gis ji ltar bgyi zhes zhus pas/ rnam snang ting nge 'dzin la zhugs pas sangs rgyas thams cad thugs khar bcug nas ting nge 'dzin sngon du 'gro bas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas khro bo shin tu 'jigs pa phyag na rdo rje thugs kha'i rdo rje las byung ste/ ma rung pa thams cad btul te dkyil 'khor la bkod nas ched brjod byas so/ /de nas rnam snang gi ting nge 'dzin sngon du 'gro ba'i hūm̐ bzhi pa'i sngags brjod phyung bas thugs kha nas sngar gyi rdor sems de nyid phyag rdor khro bo hūm̐ mdzad du gyur nas phyung ste/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas spyan drangs nas dkyil 'khor du bcug cing bcings nas gcig tu 'dus shing khro bor gyur te rnam snang gi thugs khar zhugs nas ched du brjod do/ /de nas thugs kha nas byung nas bka' nod pa la/ rnam snang gis lha chen po khug cig par bka' bsgos pas/ hūm̐ mdzad kyis rdo rje zhags pa la lha chen po 'khor bcas khug cig ces bsgos pas/ zhags pas lha chen po la/ khyed ston pas spyan 'dren mdzad ces bos pas/

de skrag cing khros te/ nga ni 'jig rten gsum rgyal po/ /nga las ston pa zhig yod dam/ /zer ba la/ rdo rje zhags pa khros pas yan lag thams cad bcings nas bkug pas/ lha thams cad 'jigs shing skrag pa na/ lha chen pos stobs shugs bstan nas zhags pa bcad de bros/ der rdo rje zhags pas hūm̐ mdzad la/ lha rnams kyis bdag bcad de bros so zhes zhus pas/ hūm̐ mdzad khros te rdo rje lcags sgrog btang pas lha chen po'i yan lag thams cad bcings nas chung ma dang bcas pa bkug pas/ yang lha chen po'i mthu stobs kyis lcags sgrog bcag nas bros pa nas/ rdo rje lcags sgrog gis bdag bcag nas bros so zhes zhus pas /hūm̐ mdzad cher khros te hūm̐ bzhi pa dang lcags kyus sngags kyi lcags kyu la bka' bsgos pas/ de'i dbang po lnga dang bcas pa'i lha tshogs thams cad gcig tu bsdus/ lcags sgrog gis bsdams/ zhags pas bcings/ lcags kyu grangs med bye ba bcu sprul te lha thams cad kyi spyi bor lcags kyus btab nas rdo rje ra ba'i phyi rol tu bkug ste rdo rje me 'bar bas gdung bas de thams cad 'o dod 'bod cing smre sngags 'don no/ /de nas rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad snying rje skyes te de rnams bcings pa las bkrol nas/ khyed rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la zhugs la nga'i bka' nyon cig ces bka' stsal pas/ lha chen po'i 'khor rnams kyis bdag cag gis ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi zer ba la/ hūm̐ mdzad kyis sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /skyabs su 'gro ba bsgrub par byos/ /kun mkhyen ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /grogs po rnams kyis bsgrub par bgyis/ /zhes gsungs pas/ lha chen po khros te/ kye gnod sbyin dang 'jig rten gsum gyi bdag po yin na/ khyod kyi ngag ci'i phyir nyan/ khyod dang khyod kyi gnas sngar ma mthong ngo zer ba la/ hūm̐ mdzad kyis drag tu bzhad nas/ nga ni gnod sbyin thams cad bza' bar byed pa ste/

ma rung pa khyod dkyil 'khor du zhugs la nga'i dam tshig la gnas par gyis/ ces bka' stsal pas/ lha chen po na re/ gnod sbyin khyod ngas ngo mi shes/ bstan pa la yang nga mi 'jug nga 'jig rten gsum gyi bdag po yin pas mthu stobs 'gran par bya'o zhes zer nas/ mdung rtse gsum gyi sngags smras pas mdung rtse gsum pa stong phrag gcig sprul/ de bzhin du khyab 'jug gis 'khor lo/ brgya byin gyis rdo rje/ gzhon nus mdung / tshangs pas dbyug tho/ lha gzhan rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi mtshon cha stong phrag re sprul nas cho 'phrul du ma dang bcas pas rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad la 'thab bo/ /de nas hūm̐ mdzad kyis mtshon cha de rnams la badz+ra sbyar ba'i snying po gsungs pas mtshon cha rnams dum bur byas nas stong pa nyid du thim/ steng 'og nas rdo rje'i mes rab tu gdungs te/ lus hrul po mi'i sha bza' ba khyod/ nga'i bka' nyon cig de lta ma yin na khyod thal bar gzhom par bya'o zhes gsungs pas/ des nga yang 'jig rten gsum gyi bdag po yin pas khyod nga'i bka' nyon cig ces zer ro/ /de nas hūm̐ mdzad kyis bcom ldan 'das la/ lha chen po 'di rang gi stobs kyis dregs nas bstan pa la 'dud du mi btub pas ji ltar bgyi zhes zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kha nas oṃ ni sum+bha badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭ ces pa dang / hūm̐ mdzad kyis kyang hūm̐ zhes brjod pas lha chen po 'khor bcas kha phub tu 'gyel lo zhes rtsa rgyud las 'byung la/ bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo nas/ hūm̐ mdzad ting nge 'dzin la zhugs nas dbu'i gtsug tor/ mdzod spu/ zhal/ thugs kha/ phrag pa/ lte ba/ phyag zhabs kyi tshigs mtshams sogs nas rdo rje gtsug tor la sogs pa'i khro bo mang po dang / gzhan yang ba spu'i bu kha rnams nas kyang khro bo dpag tu med pa rang rang gi snying pos phyung ste phyogs thams cad du spros bsdus nas dkyil 'khor la 'khod de ched du brjod do/

/de nas de rnams la hūm̐ mdzad kyis/ nga'i bka' nyon la gdug pa rnams thul cig ces bsgos pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ ni suṃ bha badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭ ces brjod pas/ lha chen 'khor bcas kha phub tu 'gyel lo zhes 'byung / de nas rdo rje me'i sngags kyis bsregs pas thams cad tshig nas 'o dod 'bod par gyur to/ /de nas khro bo rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ra a bhe sha a zhes pas khro bo rdo rje dbab pa sprul nas/ des lha thams cad la babs te rab tu sdug bsngal zhing rang gi yan lag gcig gis gcig bza' bar byed do/ /de nas khro bo lcags kyus spyi bo nas bkug nas/ zhags pas drangs/ rdo rje mes bsregs/ mgo thur du bstan nas smre sngags 'don bzhin pa la/ rdo rje lcags sgrog gis bcings pa lngas bcings nas dkyil 'khor du bcug pa la/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyis hūm̐ zhes brjod pas thams cad 'gyel te shi ba bzhin du gyur to zhes 'byung la/ rtsa rgyud ltar na 'khor rnams phyag rdor la skyabs su song zhing / dbang phyug chen po 'gyel nas shi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten gsum gyi 'khor lo 'di thams cad la skyabs byin la ma gsod cig ces gsungs pas/ de thos nas hūm̐ mdzad kyis lha rnams la bka' stsal pa/ gal te khyod srog 'dod na dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song la/ nga'i bka' nyon cig gsungs pa dang / de rnams kyis dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyod kyi bka' ma 'tshal lo zhes zer ro/ /de nas rnam snang gis lha rnams la/ kye lha rnams 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po khro bo'i rgyal po chen por dbang bskur ba ste/ lha chen po la sogs pa zhi bas ma thul ba rnams tshar bcad par bya ba'i phyir byin gyis rlabs pa ste/ de bas khyed rnams 'di'i dam tshig la gnas par gyis shig ces gsungs pas/ de dag gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gi srog bskyab tu gsol zer ba la/

'di nyid la skyabs su song shig 'di nyid kyis skyob kyi gzhan gyis ma yin no zhes gsungs pa dang / de thams cad kyis rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad la 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal las bskyab tu gsol zhes mgrin gcig tu zhus pa dang / des nga'i bstan pa la zhugs shig rdo rje 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams thal bar byed par 'gyur ta re zhes gsungs/ de rnams kyis khyed ni kun tu bzang po zhi ba dul ba lags na ci'i phyir bdag cag sreg par byed zer ba la/ des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bka' bzhin du byed pas nga ni kun tu bzang po ste/ khyed lta bu'i ma rung pa rnams sbyang ba'i phyir/ gal te nga'i dam tshig la mi gnas na chud gsan par bya'o zhes gsungs pas/ de rnams kyis de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes zhus pa dang / hūm̐ mdzad kyis badz+ro tiṣ+ṭha zhes gsungs pas lha chen po ma gtogs pa gzhan rnams brgyal ba sangs nas 'jigs pa med par gyur nas/ hūm̐ mdzad la lta zhing langs so/ /de nas rnam snang gis lha chen po yang slongs shig ces bka' stsal pas/ shi ba gso ba'i snying po oṃ ā yuḥzhes pas shi ba gsos kyang lang ma nus so/ /des rnam snang la bdag 'di lta bus 'dul lam zhes gsol pas/ rnam snang gis khyod 'dul ba po 'di nyid yin gyi nga ma yin no zhes gsungs pas/ khyed kyis ma rung pa 'di las skyabs mdzad mi spyod dam zer ba la/ ngas 'di las skyabs mi spyod do/ /nged de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po yin pa'i phyir ro gsungs pa dang / de na re/ bcom ldan 'das khyed kyis bka' stsal pa'i don bdag gis ma 'tshal te/ de bzhin gshegs pa las gzhan pa'i bdag po ma 'tshal na 'di su lags zhes gsol to/ /de nas hūm̐ mdzad kyis kyai ma rung pa'i sems can nga'i bka' mi nyan nam gsungs pas/ lha chen pos de thos nas khros shing bred nas 'jigs pa'i gzugs bstan nas/ nga shi ba gzod kyi khyod kyi ngag mi nyan no zhes smras so/

/de nas hūm̐ mdzad kyis zhabs mthil nas rdo rje rjes su spyod pa byung nas sngags kyis bka' bsgos te/ des lha chen po chung ma dang bcas pa rkang pa gyen du bstan nas hūm̐ mdzad kyi zhabs drung du bzhag go /hūm̐ mdzad kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di la ji ltar bgyi zhes zhus pas/ oṃ badz+ra me gā kra ma ho zhes bka' stsal pa dang / des lha chen po zhabs g.yon dang / u ma zhabs g.yas kyis mnan pa dang / snying po smras ma thag tu lha chen po sa la babs nas rang gi lag pa stong gis rang gi gdong la 'tshog go /khang brtsegs kyi phyi na gnas pa'i srid pa gsum gyi bdag po thams cad nged kyi dbang po 'di bdag nyid chen po 'dis btul lo zhes pa'i sgra phyung ngo / /de nas rnam snang gis byams pa'i snying po smras pas/ babs pa'i sdug bsngal zhi ste/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi zhabs kyis reg pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan thob nas lus gdan du phul te 'og gi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'das pa na thal bas kheb pa zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams su thal ba'i dbang po'i dbyangs zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs par skyes so/ /de nas lha chen po'i lus de las ched du brjod pa 'di byung ste/ e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla na med/ /yi ge'i tshig gis mnan nas su/ /mya ngan las ni 'das par bzhag /ces so/ /de nas hūm̐ mdzad kyis khyab 'jug la sogs pa 'jig rten gsum gyi bdag po rnams la grogs po rnams dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig srungs shig gsungs pas/ de rnams kyis de bzhin du bgyi'o zhus pas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa dang / dam tshig dang / sdom pa bzung la nga'i dam tshig la gnas par gyis shig gsungs pas/

de bzhin du bgyi lags te dam tshig blo bar ma chud do zer ba la/ de nas des dam tshig dang / phyag rgya dang snying po byin dkyil 'khor du bcug ste dbang bskur ro/ /de ltar 'jig rten gsum gyi 'khor lo rnams dkyil 'khor du bcug dbang bskur nas/ 'byung po'i gdon thams cad dang / mkha' 'gro'i gdon thams cad dang / ngan 'gro thams cad dgug cing sbyong ba'i phyir ston pas so so'i snying po gsungs/ hūm̐ mdzad kyis thams cad bkug nas dkyil 'khor du bcug ste/ rgyas pa la dga' ba rjes su bzung ba'i phyir 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi bshad pa dang / gzungs dkyil chos dkyil las dkyil gyi bshad pa la sogs pa rnams gsungs shing / bar ma la dga' ba rjes su bzung ba'i phyir phyag rgya bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor sprul nas de'i cho ga dang / bsdus pa la dga' ba'i don du phyag rgya gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor sprul nas de'i cho ga la sogs pa ste/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi rgyud khams gsum rnam rgyal gyis gtso bor ston pa dum bu gnyis pa 'di/ gong gi gdul bya de rnams 'dul ba dang / sbyang gzhi ngag dang 'dod chags kyi gnyen por legs par gsungs pa yin la/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgongs pa gcig tu 'dus nas/ phyag rdor nyid spyan ras gzigs kyi gzugs 'dzin pa la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mtshan brgyas bstod cing gsol ba btab nas spyan ras gzigs kyi pad+mo thugs khar kha 'byed pa'i tshul du mdzad nas ched du brjod/ rnam snang gi thugs kha nas hrīḥdang pad+mo lta bu'i 'od zer phyung bas zhing thams cad kyi chags sogs sbyangs nas spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs kar zhugs te/ de nas spyan ras gzigs kyis ting nge 'dzin la zhugs te 'gro 'dul gyi snying po gsungs nas thugs ka'i pad+mo las dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sprul/ de dag gis gdul bya btul slar dkyil 'khor la 'khod de spyan gzigs kyi 'gro 'dul gyi rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/

gzungs dkyil/ chos dkyil/ las dkyil te dkyil 'khor bzhi rgyas pa la dga' ba'i sems can gyi don du bstan nas/ bar pa dang bsdus pa la dga' ba'i don du phyag rgya bzhi pa dang gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams rim bzhin bstan te/ mdor na pad+ma'i rigs kyi rgyud 'gro 'dul gyi dkyil 'khor gyis gtso bor ston pa dum bu gsum pa 'di yid dang zhe sdang gi gnyen por gsungs pa yin no/ /de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus nas/ rdo rje 'chang nyid nam snying gi gzugs 'dzin pa la bstod cing gsol ba btab/ nam snying ting nge 'dzin la zhugs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas rin po che lta bu'i 'od zer byung nas zhing sbyangs shing nam snying gi thugs kar zhugs/ de'i thugs ka nas rin po che las rin chen rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sprul/ zhing thams cad du nor gyi char 'bebs pa'i don byas slar dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ de nas nam snying gis rgyas pa la dga' ba'i don du dkyil 'khor bzhi dang / bar pa dang / bsdus pa'i don du don grub kyi phyag rgya bzhi pa dang gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa bstan nas rin chen rigs kyi rgyud don grub kyi dkyil 'khor gtso bor ston pa dum bu bzhi pa 'di sbyang gzhi sgo gsum gyi byed las dang / ser sna dang phrag dog gi gnyen por legs par gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid kyi rang bzhin sems can thams cad kyi thun mong du gyur pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud bstan nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa gong ma'i yang gong ma'i sems can rjes su bzung ba'i don du rgyud phyi ma dang / de nas bsgom pa la 'jigs shing bya ba la mngon par zhen pa'i sems can rjes su bzung ba'i don du phyag rdor gyis/ lta ba ngan zhing chags bral las/

/zhes sogs kyis bshad par dam bcas nas rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma gsungs so/ /de nas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor bsdus nas 'og min du gshegs pa'i tshul ston pa sogs ston byed kyi rgyud don nye bar bsdus pa zhes bya ba gsungs pa yin no/ /de nas bshad pa'i rgyud rnams kyi rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud la gnas gsal bar ma gsungs kyang / bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba'i 'grel par ri rab kyi steng du gsungs par bshad/ bla ma gong ma dag rtsa rgyud dang mthun par lha gnas gsum du gsungs shing / ston pa dang 'khor dang gnas rnams kyang rtsa rgyud dang mtshungs par bzhed do/ /de yang / de nas rdo rje rgyal po mchog /kun mchog srid pa'i dbang phyug gi /'khor lo can ni rtags byas nas/ /rnal 'byor can ni mi gsungs bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs pas rtsa ba'i rgyud yongs su rdzogs par bshad pa'i rjes la/ 'khor los bsgyur ba cang mi gsungs par bzhugs pa la sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus nas gsol ba btab par bzhed do/ /thams cad gsang ba la ni gleng gzhi med la/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal pa'i rtog pa'i rgyal po ni/ ston pa rnam par snang mdzad gnas ri rab kyi rtse mor khang pa brtsegs pa rdo rje dang rin po che la sogs pas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang du/ 'khor byang sems bye ba phrag du ma dang / lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin sogs bstan pa la dga' ba rnams dang lhan cig bzhugs pa'i tshe phyag rdor nam mkha'i dkyil nas babs te/ rnam snang la phyag dang bskor ba byas nas/ lha chen po la sogs pa'i ma rung pa rnams la dam tshig 'dzin du 'jug par 'tshal na/ de'i slad du bka' stsal du gsol/ zhes zhus pas/ khyod shin tu khro ba 'di rnams kyi phyir 'di lta bu'i sngags kyi tshig smra gsungs pas/ bdag sems can ma rung pa gdul bar 'tshal lo/ /btul nas bla na med pa'i bde la 'god par 'tshal lo zhes zhus pa na/ legs so legs so/

/de'i phyir snying po smros shig gsungs pa dang / de nas phyag rdor gyis lha nas ma mo'i bar la/ grogs po dag sangs rgyas la skyabs su song la/ nga'i bka' nyon cig ces smras te rnam snang la phyag 'tshal nas sum+bha ni smras pa/ 'jig rten gsum po g.yos/ lha la sogs pa 'dar yed yed gyur pa dang / kyai grogs po rnams dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song la/ nga'i bka' skyongs shig ces smras pa dang / 'khor phal cher skyabs su song / lha chen po dang / khyab 'jug dang / tshangs pa rnams kyis rnam snang la 'di ltar mthu che zhing rdzu 'phrul che la bdag cag la 'chos pa 'di su lags zhus pas/ sems can gyi don gyi phyir sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i kun tu bzang po'o zhes gsungs/ de nas phyag rdor gyis kyai lha dag sangs rgyas la skyabs su song la nga'i bka' nyon cig rdo rje 'bar bas bsreg par 'gyur ta re/ lha chen pos smras pa/ khyod ni gnod sbyin/ nged ni lha yin pas khyod kyi bka' mi nyan no zer ba dang / phyag na rdo rje khros nas rnam snang la zhus pas/ rnam snang gis lha chen po la bskul ba dang / des bdag cag thams cad dbang po yin pas mi nyan no zhus pas/ phyag rdor khros nas/ lus hrul po mi'i sha bza' ba khyod dbang phyug la sogs pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas dbang phyug khros nas gzugs dang mtshon cha sna tshogs sprul nas 'thab par brtsams pa dang / phyag rdor khros nas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas 'jig rten g.yos pas lha'i tshogs rnam snang la skyabs su song ba dang / phyag rdor gyis sum+bha ni gsungs pas lha chen 'khor bcas mgo rkang ldog ste dkyil 'khor du bcug nas phyag rdor gyi zhabs kyis mnan to/ /rnam snang gis legs so byin nas dbugs phyungs gsungs pas rdo rje bcings pa'i sngags kyis gsos dran pa rnyed pa dang / ston pas phyag rdor gyi bka' nyan par bskul nas khas blangs pa dang /

phyag rdor gyis rang gi snying pos dbang du byas te sems bskyed cing dkyil 'khor du bcug ste dam tshig dang sdom pa phog nas dbang bskur ro/ /de nas phyag rdor gyis/ gdon dang mkha' 'gro ma dang rims dang ngan song la ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ dam tshig la nan tan byed du chug cig gsungs nas dam tshig la bkod do/ /de nas mi rnams ji ltar gdul bar bgyi zhus pas/ dkyil 'khor chen po dang dam tshig dang rdo rje dang las kyi dkyil 'khor du chug cig gsungs nas/ phyag rdor gyis lha rnams kyi sku'i gsang ba bstan pa dkyil 'khor chen po dang / gsung gi gsang ba ston pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dang / sems kyi gsang ba ston pa dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor dang / spyod pa sna tshogs kyi gsang ba ston pa las kyi dkyil 'khor rnams bri zhing 'jug pa sogs kyi cho ga dang / las kyi sbyor ba sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi cho ga la sogs pa'i sgo nas khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi rtog pa chen po gsungs pa yin la/ yang cha mthun gyi rgyud/ rnams gsungs tshul ni/ ston pa rnam snang / gnas 'dod pa'i khams kyi gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i rgyal po'i gnas kyi gzhal med khang na/ 'khor phyag rdor la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor bye ba phrag brgyad dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs nas/ sher phyin gyi tshul rnam par dag pa'i gnas bcu bdun ston zhing / 'dod khams kyi dbang phyug gdul ba'i phyir btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang na bzhugs pa'i rab tu dga' ba chen po'i skur sprul pa de mthong zhing / 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug rang gi chung ma'i 'khor mi sdug par mthong nas/ ston pa la phyag byas te/ khyed kyi phun sum tshogs pa 'di gang gis thob par gyur zhus pas/ de'i phyir du skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed la bkod nas yul spangs pas thar pa thob par 'dod pas skrag par 'gyur bas rnam par dag pa'i gnas bcu bdun lha mo'i tshul du bstan pas rab tu dga' ba'i bde ba chen po 'byung bar bstan nas de la nyan pa dang sems pa'i phan yon bshad pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas dpal mchog sher dum dang sngags dum gsungs pa yin no/

/rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud ni/ ston pa rnam snang / gnas rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po 'od gsal ba'i gzhal med khang na/ 'khor zhing thams cad kyi rdul dang mnyam pa'i byang chub sems dpas bskor te/ rnam snang gis 'jam dpal la/ sangs rgyas dang rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad spyan drongs shig gsungs/ des kyang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas bsdus/ rnam snang gis bh+rum̐ zhes gsungs pas sangs rgyas thams cad rnam snang thugs su zhugs pas rnam snang zhal bzhi par gyur te/ rnam dag gi gnas nyi shu dang / bh+rum̐ dang / hūm̐ dang / am̐ dang / hūm̐ dang / hri dang / tram̐ dang / āḥdang / āḥdang / hūm̐ dang / oṃ dang / ha dang / hrīḥdang / hrīḥdang / bh+yo dang / hūm̐ ste sher phyin gyi tshul gyi chos kyi sgo'i chos kyi rnam grangs phan yon dang bcas pa dang / sher phyin sgo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa phan yon dang bcas pa bstan pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas gsungs so/ /gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud ni/ ston pa rnam snang / gnas sku gsung thugs ye shes rgyan chen po bkod pa'i snying po la/ 'khor nam mkha'i khams kyi rdul phran dang mnyam pa'i lha mo'i tshogs dang lhan cig bzhugs te/ sangs rgyas thams cad la yum gyi glus bstod nas yum gyi dkyil 'khor zhus pas/ sku gsung thugs ye shes yum chen mo'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa bstan pa'i sgo nas gsungs so/ /gsang ba nor bu'i thig le'i rgyud ni/ ston pa rnam snang / gnas 'og min lha'i rgyal po'i khang bzang na/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs te/ phyag rdor gyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor gsungs so/ /rab tu gnas pa mdor bsdus pa'i rgyud ni/ ston pa rnam snang ting nge 'dzin la zhugs nas/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten/ gnas byed kyi slob dpon/ gang du bya ba'i gnas/ rab gnas ma byas pa'i nyes dmigs/ byas pa'i phan yon/

don dam par rab gnas med kyang kun rdzob tu dgos pa rab gnas kyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi cho ga dus nam gyi tshe bya ba dang bcas pa gsungs so/ /ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa ni/ snga rabs pa rnams kyi gsung bgros la/ rgyud chung 'di la brtag pa gnyis/ /brtag pa gnyis la ston pa gsum/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyud 'di la gzhung tshad sh+lo ka stong dang / bam po gsum yod cing / brtag pa gong 'og gnyis yod la/ brtag pa dang po ni/ ston pa gnas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi dga' ba'i tshal gyi gzhal yas khang na 'khor brgya byin la sogs pa'i 'jig rten pa dang / byang sems bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dang thabs gcig tu pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs te/ ngan song gi rgyud thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la zhugs pas mdzod spu nas 'od zer bkye bas sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las grol bde ba so sor thob nas/ dga' ba'i tshul thams cad snang bar byas bcom ldan 'das mchod cing phyag 'tshal nas/ e ma sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas/ /zhes sogs kyis ched du brjod/ de nas brgya byin gyis de la ngo mtshar zhus pas/ sangs rgyas kyis che ba'i yon tan gsungs pa dang / lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od gar skyes zhus pas/ mnar med du skyes pa dang de'i sdug bsngal sogs gsungs pas/ lha rnams 'jigs te skyobs par zhus pas zhal gyis bzhes/ de nas brgya byin gyis zhus nas/ dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyang ba la sogs pa ro yod pa dang med pa la brten nas sdig pa sbyong thabs rnams gsungs pa dang / brgya byin gyis cho ga byas pas nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od dmyal ba las thar te dga' ldan du skyes pa dang / lha rnams ngo mtshar skyes te ston pa la ched du brjod cing / lha'i bu de nyid kyang byung nas mchod pa rgya chen po byas nas song ngo /

/de nas brgya byin la sogs pa ngo mtshar nas/ cho ga'i phan yon zhus pas rgyas par bka' stsal/ de rnams kyis kyang bsrung bar khas blangs/ ston pas kyang bsrung bar gdams te kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ston pa brtag pa dang po gsungs so/ /de nas phyag rdor gdan las langs nas ston pa la phyag byas te/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin la zhugs nas dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang / gshin po'i don bya ba dang / 'di nyid dang kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor la dgos pa'i phyag rgya'i tshogs la sogs pa rnams gsungs shing / tshangs pa la sogs pas zhus pa'i ngor lha'i bu dri ma med pa'i sngon gyi skyes rabs la sogs pa bshad de shākya thub pa'i dkyil 'khor gsungs la/ de bzhin du phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rdor la rgyal chen bzhis bskor ba dang / phyogs skyong bcus bskor ba dang / gza' brgyad rgyu skar dang bcas pas bskor ba dang / klu chen brgyad kyis bskor ba dang / 'jigs byed brgyad kyis bskor ba dang / lha chen brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor te phyag rdor gtso bor byas pa'i dkyil 'khor bdun dang / gzhan yang tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor/ me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor te brtag pa phyi ma nas dkyil 'khor bcu gcig bstan pa'i dang po bcu phrag na rdo rje zhi ba sngar brtag pa dang po gsungs pa'i tshe ston pa'i 'khor na yod pa de 'chad pa por byin gyis brlabs nas gsungs shing / dkyil 'khor bcu gcig pa me ltar 'bar ba ni gdul bya ma rungs pa rnams 'dul ba'i don du sngar gyi phyag na rdo rje zhi ba de nyid khro bo 'jig rten gsum rgyal du bsgyur te gsungs pa yin no/ /des na sbyong rgyud 'di la gsungs pa po'i ston pa ldog pas phye na gsum dang / ngo bo'i sgo nas gsum char ston pa shāka thub nyid du gcig par bshad pa yin la/

yang 'di'i brtag pa phyogs gcig pa gtsug dgu'i rgyud du grags pa ni/ gleng gzhi phal cher sbyong rgyud dang 'dra ba la/ gong gi kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / 'og gi shākya thub pa'i dkyil 'khor go brjes shing cho ga'i yan lag rnams rdor dbyings kyi rgyas bkab pa zhig yod par bshad la/ gzhan rgyud rang gi ngo bo la snga ma dang khyad par med pa zhig yod par gsungs/ 'di la bu ston rin po ches 'di rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dag gis byas pa yin min brtag go /gsungs nas rgyud yin min the tshom can du bzhed/ bo dong paṇa chen gyis 'di la kha cig paṇ+ḍi tas byas par the tshom med do zer ba la ni sgrub byed cung zad kyang med pas rgyud rnam dag yin no zhes gsungs/ rang lugs kyi mkhas pa dag gi gsung las/ rgyud min pa nyid 'thad de/ 'di'i gsham gyi tshigs bcad du/ kun snying dang / 'jigs med sbas pa'i man ngag la brten nas brtsams zhes 'byung ba'i phyir zhes gsungs nas rgyud ma yin par bzhed pa yin no/ /de ltar ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rtsa ba dang bshad rgyud cha mthun gyi rgyud rnams legs par gsungs nas/ de dag bsdu pa po ni ji ltar bsdus pa'i tshul ni/ dus 'og min du bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud la sogs pa gsungs pa'i rjes thogs su/ gnas rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can du/ bsdu pa po sa bcu'i dbang phyug gi tshul 'dzin pa'am/ rdo rje 'chang gi nyan pa'i 'khor 'dzam bu'i gling til gyi sa bon gyis gang ba bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kun tu gang bar snang ba la/ zhu ba po'i 'khor kun tu bzang po la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gsol ba btab pas/ rang nyid tshad ma'i skyes bu sangs rgyas su bsgrub pa'i phyir dang / thos pa yang dag par bstan pa'i don du sngar ji skad bshad pa'i don blo la gnas par byas nas/

dus dang / gnas dang / ston pa dang / 'khor phun sum tshogs pa 'dzoms pa'i dus su chos phun sum tshogs pa 'di thos zhes ston pas 'di skad bdag gis thos nas/ mngon par bstod/ de'i bar gsungs la/ kun tu bzang po la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rjes su yi rang zhing mngon par bstod par gyur pa de nyid snang bar bshad pa yin no/ /spyir gsang sngags kyi theg pa bsdus tshul ni/ dpal ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na gsang ba'i rgyud skal ba ldan pa la sus bshad par byed/ bka' stsal pa/ phyag na rdo rje mgon pos bshad par byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gsang ba'i sgron me las/ gsang ba chen po'i rgyud shes pa dang bshad pa ma 'ongs pa na sus byed/ bka' stsal pa/ byang phyogs u rgyan gyi yul dpal rdo rje chen po'i gnas su u rgyan gyi rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti zhes bya bas shes pa dang / bshad pa dang / sems can la gsal bar byed do zhes sogs gsungs pas na/ gnas u rgyan gyi yul du bsdu pa po gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'o/ /dus bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa'i dus su rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde mtha' dag bsdus nas rgyal chen in+d+ra bhu ti 'khor dang bcas pa la byin pas/ de dag gis kyang dngos grub thob par bshad pa ltar yin no/ /spyi don gnyis pa rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sgra don dang dbye ba bstan pa ni/ sgra pa rnams kyis yo tsir sbyor ba la'o/ /zhes bshad pas na/ shing gnyis phan tshun sbyar te lcags gzer la sogs pas bsdams te ya mi 'bral bar byed pa ltar/ brjod bya thabs dang / shes rab gnyis phan tshun ya ma bral bar dbyer med du bsres nas zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa'i chos yin pas na/ rnal 'byor zhes bya ba yin te/ gsang 'dus las/ rnal 'byor thabs kyis ma yin zhing / /rnal 'byor shes rab gcig pus min/ /thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug la/

/rnal 'byor de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /zhes dang / 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rtog pa'i 'grel pa las/ de la rnal 'byor zhes bya ba sems mnyam par gzhag pa'o/ /de'i mthus sngags kyi sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i dgos pa sgrub pa'i phyir sngags dang phyag rgya dang dkyil 'khor du dbang sbyin pa la sogs pa sna tshogs sbrel zhing brgyus pas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ces bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar thabs shes gnyis po de yang gang zhe na/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ zab cing rgya che zhes bya gang / /rnam par rtog med zab pa ste/ /rgya che sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku/ /'di ni bden pa gnyis su bshad/ /ces gsungs pas thabs rgya che ba snang phyogs lha sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa snang la rang bzhin med pa'i tshul dang / de nyid shes rab zab mo stong pa nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar nyams len gcig gi steng du dbyer med zung 'jug tu nyams su len pas na yo ga'am rnal 'byor zhes bya zhing / de nyid brjod byar ston pa'i rgyud sde rnams la yang yo ga'i rgyud dam rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ces bya ste/ rdo rje rtse mor/ rnal 'byor don ni ci yin brjod/ /chos rgya chen po dam pa dang / /zab mo'i mchog tu gyur pa de/ /kun shes kun rig ldan 'byor pa/ /rnal 'byor don du rjod par byed/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /de lta bu'i rgyud la dbye na/ slob dpon pad+ma lcags kyus/ rtsa rgyud zab cing shin tu rtogs dka' ba/ /bshad rgyud cha mthun rgyud kyis gsal bar byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / bshad pa'i rgyud/ cha mthun gyi rgyud dang gsum du yod pa las/ dang po la rtsa rgyud zhes pa yang thog mar byung zhing bshad gzhir gyur pas na de skad du 'jog ste/ de nyid 'dus pa zhes pa'i rgyud de nyid yin la/ de la yang dum bu bzhir yod pa'i/

dang pos sbyang gzhi sems can gyi lus dang gti mug gi gnyen por rnam snang gtso bor gyur pa'i rdor dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor ston cing / gnyis pas ngag 'dod chags kyi gnyen por khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dkyil 'khor ston la/ gsum pas yid dang zhe sdang gi gnyen por 'gro 'dul gyi dkyil 'khor ston/ bzhi pas sgo gsum gyi byed las dang ser sna dang phrag dog gi gnyen por don thams cad grub pa'i dkyil 'khor ston pa yin no/ /yang dum bu bzhi pa'i rjes su rgyud phyi ma dang / phyi ma'i phyi ma rgyud don gnyer bsdus zhes kyang bya ba ste gsum yod pa'i dang po gnyis ni rgyud kyi kha skong lta bu yin par bshad de/ dang pos ni dum bu bzhi pa'i skabs skabs kyi kha skong bar byed/ bar pas ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud thams cad cho ga rgyas pa'i sgo nas nyams su len dgos na snyigs ma'i sems can la phan mi thogs sam snyam pa la/ sngon la sems dpa' gcig rdzogs sogs bsdus pa'i cho ga gsungs nas dogs pa de bsal ba yin zhing / gsum pas ni sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor bsdus nas 'og min du gshegs pa'i tshul ston pa sogs gsungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bshad pa'i rgyud la/ so so'i bshad rgyud dang / thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud gnyis las bshad rgyud ces pa yang phyis byung zhing 'chad byed du gyur pas na de skad ces bya zhing / so so'i bshad rgyud la yang / dum bu dang po'i bshad rgyud rdo rje'i dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gtso bor ston pas thams cad gsang ba dang / dum bu gnyis pa'i bshad rgyud 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rtog pa dang gnyis su yod la/ dum bu phyi ma gnyis la thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud bod du ma 'gyur bar bshad do/ /gnyis pa thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud ni/ rdo rje rtse mo'am/ badz+ra shi ṣa ri yi rgyud dam/ yang rigs sngags kyi byed pa ston pas na/

gsang ba 'dus pa sogs su 'di'i lung drangs par/ sngags kyi rgya che rol pa zhes kyang gsungs pa ste mtshan gyi rnam grangs gsum dang ldan pa'i rgyud de nyid yin no/ /'di'i nang nas rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor bcu dang / rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor gcig 'byung bar yang bshad do/ /gsum pa cha mthun gyi rgyud la/ cha mthun zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan/ cho ga'i spyi chings rtsa rgyud de nyid du 'dus pa dang 'dra zhing / de nas bzhugs pa ji lta ba bzhin med pas na rtsa dang cha mthun pa zhes bya zhing / de la phye na dpal mchog gi rgyud/ ngan song sbyong rgyud/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ gsang ba nor bu'i rgyud/ gsang pa rgyan gyi rgyud/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ rab gnas kyi rgyud la sogs pa mang du yod do/ /dang po dpal mchog gi rgyud la sher dum dang sngags dum gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed du yo ga'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i bkod pa mdzad nas/ sher phyin gyi mdo rnams dang mthun par gsungs shing / de nas phyag na rdo rjes zhus pa'i don du 'khor rnams la dpal mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas/ da ni de dag gi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ zhes sher dum gyi nang gi a zhes bya ba ni ma skyes pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o zhes pa lta bu la dkyil 'khor re ston pa dang bcas pas gsungs so/ /'di nas rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor bcu gsum/ rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor gcig ste bcu bzhi ston par bshad do/ /bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas su ga ta shrī la gsan nas bsgyur ba'i/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa/ gsang ba nor bu'i thig le gsum gyi/ dang pos rnam snang gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor sgo bcu sbrags yod pa gcig ston/ gzhan gnyis nas rnam snang gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor re re ston la/

phyi ma 'di dpal mchog dang mthun pa zhig yod par yang bshad do/ /mtshan brjod ni sgyu 'phrul dra ba khri drug stong yod pa'i nang nas 'jam dpal gyi don dam pa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pa glur blangs pa phan yon dang bcas pa zur du phyung pa yin no/ /rab gnas kyi rgyud ni/ rab gnas kyi rgyud rgyas pa gcig gi le'u dang po zur du phyung ba yin zhing / bla med dang thun mong ba lta bu'i rgyud du snang yang / bla ma gong ma dag gis yo ga'i rgyud kyi khongs su 'dren par mdzad pa ltar bkod pa yin no/ /de ltar gong du bstan pa'i rgyud rnams kyi nang nas dpal ldan ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud 'di 'ga' zhig spyod pa'i rgyud du 'dod cing / bu ston rin po che'i bzhed pas/ spyir rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ cha mthun pa'i rgyud/ 'phros pa'i yan lag gi rgyud dang drug tu mdzad nas/ sbyong rgyud 'di phyi ma yan lag gi rgyud yin te/ de nyid bsdus pa'i dum bu gnyis pa las/ ngan 'gro dgug cing sdig pa dral ba la 'phros nas ngan song sbyong ba'i thabs rgya cher rgyud der bstan pas na 'phros pa'i rgyud dam de nyid kyi rtsa ba'i lha phal cher dum bu dang po'i lha dang 'dra zhing / de'i cha shas su gyur pas na yan lag gi rgyud yin pas so zhes gsungs kyang / rang lugs kyi bla ma gong ma phal cher gyi gsung rgyun las rgyud sde bzhi'i nang nas yo ga'i rgyud/ de la yang gtso bor rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud/ cha mthun gyi rgyud dang gsum du yod pa'i nang nas cha mthun gyi rgyud yin par bshad la/ yang 'chad thabs kyi man ngag gi sgo nas rtsa rgyud sogs rgyud sde gzhan la ma ltos pa'i rgyud rang skya tshugs pa zhig yin par yang gsungs te/ spyir rgyud 'chad tshul la/ 'grel pas 'chad pa dang / gzhung phran gyis 'chad pa dang / rgyud nyid kyis 'chad pa'i tshul dang gsum du yod pa las/

dang po ni dus 'khor lta bu/ gnyis pa ni gsang ba 'dus pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni ngan song sbyong rgyud lta bu yin te/ brtag pa dang po rtsa rgyud kyi tshul du byas nas/ brtag pa phyi ma bshad rgyud kyi tshul du gsungs pa'i sgo nas rgyud 'di rang gi gong 'og 'khrugs sdebs nas yo ga gzhan nas kha skong ba la sogs ha cang mi dgos par 'di rang nas dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po'i cho ga'i rnam gzhag gsal bar ston pas so zhes kyang sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rgyun sgra tshad pa dkon mchog rgya mtshos zin bris su mdzad pa'i kun rig gi dbang gi mtshams sbyor las 'byung ba yin no/ /spyi don gsum pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud 'di mi yul du dus nam byung ba'i tshul ni/ dpal sdom pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /lo ni brgyad dang bcu gnyis na/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /lha gnas gsum du grags pa de/ /'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su/ /dpal zhes bya ba'i ri bo la/ /thugs rje mthun pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la/ /lag na rdo rjes gnang bar byed/ /mi las skal ldan dam pa rnams/ /byang chub mchog tu grub 'gyur bas/ /de la rtag tu gus par byos/ /zhes 'byung bas/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgyad dang bcu gnyis te/ nyi shu rtsa brgyad na rgya gar shar lho'i phyogs grong khyer parti kirti zhes bya bar rgyal po rab gsal zla ba zhes bya ba la/ phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor sprul nas dbang bskur te/ lha gnas gsum du grags pa de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud la sogs pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud mtha' dag gnang nas mi yul du dar ba yin la/ de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud la lha gnas gsum pa zhes pa yang / rgyud 'di dang po 'og min du gsungs/ bar du ri rab kyi rtser gsungs/ tha ma lcang lo can du gsungs pas na mtshan de skad du grags pa yin no/

/de la kha cig gis dang po sprul bshad ri rab kyi rtser mdzad pas lha gnas dang po ri rab kyi rtse yin gyi/ 'og min du slar zlos te gsungs pas lha gnas gnyis pa 'og min no zhes zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ de nyid snang bar/ de'i don 'di sngar ston pa yin te/ 'di ltar ri rab kyi steng du 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rang bzhin gyi bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' de kho na nyid bsdus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis 'og min gyi gnas su mngon par byang chub pa las mngon sum du mdzad pa'i rjes thogs nyid la/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la sogs pa la thog mar gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes thog mar 'og min du gsungs par bshad pas lha gnas dang po yang 'og min la ngos 'dzin rigs pa yin no/ /gong gi lung don la kha cig rgyal po dza'i khang thog tu gsang sngags kyi glegs bam mang po babs pa la bltas pas gzhan ma shes par rdo rje sems dpa' zhal mthong gi le'u shes nas bsgrubs pas grub pa thob ces zer/ 'ga' zhig des ma shes par dge slong ku ku ri la dris pas/ des kyang gzhan ma shes par rdo rje sems dpa' zhal mthong gi le'u shes nas bsgrubs pas grub pa thob/ slar thams cad shes nas rgyal po la bstan pas rgyal po 'khor bcas kyang grub pa thob zhes zer ba ni/ gsang sngags rang nyid len pa ni/ /lus can dmyal ba 'ba' zhig rgyu/ /zhes pa la sogs pa dang 'gal bas mi 'thad pa nyid du slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo'i rgyud sde spyi rnam du gsungs so/ /rgyud sde spyi rnam gyi bshad tshul de la bu ston rin po ches/ bla ma kha cig de ltar na gsang sngags rang nyid kyis len par 'gyur zhing / bla ma med par mi 'grub par bshad pa dang yang 'gal la/ lag na rdo rjes gnang bar bshad pa yang dgag mi nus pas rang bzo mkhan gyi rdzun gtam yin no zhes gsungs mod kyi/

'on te lung de drangs pa'i rgyud dang / de 'grel pa yang dag tu drangs pa ma mthong la/ rgyal po tsa dang dza gnyis kyang yi ge la gang yod la rag ste/ tsa yin na dza'i bshad pa mi rung / dza yin na tsa'i bshad pa mi rung ngo zhes gsungs la/ de la rgyal po tsa dang dza gnyis gang dag gi rnam dbye spyi rnam du gsal kha can ma gsungs shing / rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung rgyun zin bris 'ga' zhig las/ rgyal po tsa zhes bya ste/ tsan+d+ra pra se na ste/ bod skad du rab gsal zla ba/ de la phyag na rdo rjes rdor dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor sprul nas/ tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad yo gar bkral ba'i man ngag gnang ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs nas tsa dag par bshad de/ 'di ni 'thad ldan yin par sems te/ gong gi lung des rgyal po rab gsal zla ba la phyag na rdo rjes yo ga'i rgyud rnams 'chad par 'gyur ba lung bstan pa yin par ni thams cad mthun la/ de lta bu'i rgyal po de'i mtshan du dza zhes pa'i don dang tha snyad gang yang ma byung zhing / tsa zhes pa ltar na tsan+d+ra zla ba'i skad dod yin pas rab gsal zla ba'i zla ba zhes pa de bstan pa yin pas so snyam mo/ /yang sher phyin gyi tshul brgya lnga bcu pa'i 'grel par/ lo rgyus 'di ltar yang 'byung ste/ ston pa sangs rgyas mi yul na lo brgyad cu bzhugs pa'i tshe sarba bud+dha sa ma yo ga dang / gu h+ya sa ma dza la sogs pas 'dul zhing / theg pa de dag gi snod du gyur pa 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi'i yul na med pas/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum dang / dga' ldan la sogs pa'i gnas na lha rnams dang / bskal ba bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa snod du gyur nas de'i tshe mdo sde de na bzhugs so/ /slad kyi sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu za hor gyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa ngo mtshar du chos la dad pa gcig 'dug pa theg pa de dag gi 'dul skal du gyur cing snod du gyur nas sarba bud+dha sa ma yo ga la sogs mdo sde bco brgyad/

phyag na rdo rje'i byin gyi rlabs kyis za hor gyi yul du babs pa na/ za hor gyi rgyal po in+d+ra bhu tis mdo sde dag bltas pa na brda ma 'phrod nas/ sngon gyi las kyi dbang gis mngon par shes pa thob pas bltas pas/ dbus kyi yul ma la ba na a tsar+ya ku ku ra/ nyin zhing ni khyi stong tsam la chos 'chad/ nyin zhing ni de dag dam tshig la longs spyod mdzad cing / bzhugs pa de theg pa'i snod du gyur la/ bdag 'dul skal du gyur pa la yang 'dra nas/ rgyal pos pho nya gtad/ slob dpon gshegs su gsol ba btab pa dang / slob dpon de yang sngon gyi las kyi dbang gis na mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan na/ rgyal po bdag gi 'dul skal du babs sam ma babs/ mdo sde de'i snod du bdag gyur ma gyur brtags pa nas/ rgyal po bdag gi 'dul skal du yang babs/ bdag mdo sde'i snod du yang gyur/ rgyal po'i the tshom yang sel bar 'gyur mod kyi/ 'on kyang mdo sde dag sngon du ma bltas na brgya la rgyal po'i the tshom dag sel par ma gyur na shin tu ma legs pas/ pho nya la slar springs pa/ mdo sde dag kho bos sngar blta ma 'tshal gyi tshur skur cig gsungs pas/ mdo sde dag tshur gshegs te bltas pa na mgo mjug gar blta'i cha ma mchis nas de nyid du lus brdabs te/ mgon med do skyabs med do zhes bos pa dang / dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mngon par gshegs te khyod ci 'dod dris pa dang / bdag mdo sde zab mo 'di bltas pa tsam gyis shes par 'dod do zhes gsol pas de bzhin gnang ngo gsungs nas/ de nas sarba bud+dha sa ma yo ga la sogs pa'i glegs bam rnams bklags pas de dag gi don yid la mngon du gsal bar gyur to/ /de nas slob dpon des za hor gyi yul du gshegs nas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la chos de dag bshad do/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpas lung bstan nas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor rnams bsgom du stsal te/

dbus su rgyal po nyid/ btsun mo dam pa bzhi yum bzhi'i sar bkod/ sras mo rnams nang gi lha mo'i sar bkod/ btsun mo phal pa rnams phyi'i lha mo'i sar bkod/ blon po phal pa rnams sgo srung bzhi/ skal ba bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' ltar bkod pa dang / rgyal po'i bsam pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams rig 'dzin gyi gnas su grub pa'i phyi nas chos 'di mi nub par bya ba'i phyir sras shākya pu ni rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur nas/ a tsar+ya ku ku ri las lung dang man ngag bstan pa rnams rgyal bu de la bstan te bzhag nas bsgoms pa dang / rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa stong pa dang / sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rig 'dzin du grub bo/ /de'i sras shākya pu tis kyang de bzhin du bsgoms pas 'khor bdun brgya dang bcas pa rig 'dzin du grub bo/ /yang rgyal bu shākya pu ti'i sras ni chung ste sras mo go ma de wi la/ dpal dam pa'i nang nas tshul brgya lnga bcu pa bkod de bshams nas in+d+ra bhu ti'i lung de sras mo yul dang sa 'dzin du bcas pa de la bstan pa las/ sras mo de yang 'khor brgya dang bcas pa rig 'dzin du grub bo/ /de nas sras mo'i de'i rgyal bu la lung dang man ngag bzhag pa las 'phel ba ni deng sang gi bar du 'di dag lags te zhes 'byung ba yin la/ gtam rgyus de dang mthun par rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti che chung gsum la brgyud nas/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ klu byang / ye shes rdo rje/ de nas slob dpon kun snying la brgyud par 'ga' zhig 'chad par byed do/ /spyi don bzhi pa rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lam srol ji ltar dar ba'i tshul la/ 'phags yul du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul dang / bod yul du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni rgyal po rab gsal zla ba zhes bya ba de la slob ma'i mchog rgyal bu sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ ye shes rdo rje/ pradzñā sid+dhi/ rab 'byor bskyangs dang bzhi byung ba las/

ye shes rdo rje zhes bya bas rdo rje dbyings kyi sgrub thabs thugs rje 'byung ba'i sgom bzlas zhes pa mdzad la/ pradzñā sid+dhis rdo rje dbyings la brten pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i sgrub thabs dang / dpal chen rgya che zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang / kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang gsum mdzad ces grag go /rab gsal zla ba'i slob ma bzhi la kha cig gong ma gsum dang / swa ti pha la dang bzhi yin gyi rab 'byor bskyangs ni kun snying gi rgyud slob yin no zhes zer ba dang / 'ga' zhig nyi ma'i snying po dang bzhi yin zer ba la sogs pa 'dod tshul mang na yang / rang lugs ni rje btsun chen po'i rdo rje 'byung ba'i lo rgyus su/ dpal rdo rje 'chang chen po'i thugs yang dag pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje sems dpas/ grong khyer pā ti kirti zhes bya bar sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor sprul nas/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba la dbang bskur nas rgyud thams cad snang ba byin pa'o/ /de'i slob ma ni rgyal bu sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ gzhan yang ye shes rdo rje/ pradzñā sid+dhi dang / rab 'byor bskyangs dang bzhi'o zhes gsungs pas gong du bkod pa ltar 'khrul pa med do/ /rab gsal zla ba'i slob ma bzhi char gyi slob ma grub chen kun snying ste/ 'di ni 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ yi ge a ming bdag nyid che/ /ston pa'i bstan pa gces 'dzin byed/ /blo ldan yon tan kun gyis bkur/ /zhes lung bstan/ yul shar phyogs bhaṅga lar 'khrungs shing / rten gyi mchog sdom pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi nang nas dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa/ 'tsho ba bsod snyoms kyis 'tsho zhing bsog 'jog spangs pas zang zing la gces par mi 'dzin/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dang rang nyid kyi bar na brgyud pa gnyis las med pas gdams pa la byin rlabs phyin ci ma log par ldan cing / rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta mthar phyin pa ste/

kun dga' snying po rig pa'i mchog /ces so/ /khyad par du gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son te mang du thos pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ /gzhan yang yi dam gyi lha mnyes par byas pas/ sgrol ma dkar mos byin brlabs shing phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa yin te/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i bstod pa las kyang / sgrol ma dkar mos byin gyis brlabs/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la 'grel bshad mdzad/ /kun dga' snying po zhes bya ba'i/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod pas so/ /de lta bu'i slob dpon chen po de grong khyer pā ti kirti na bsod snyoms mdzad kyin bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi nub phyogs nas slob dpon pradzñā wa li ta bya bas gsang sngags kyi chos 'tshol du byon te/ grong khyer pa rnams la rgyal po rab gsal zla ba'i slob ma sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po dang / ye shes rdo rje dang / pradzñā sid+dhi dang / rab 'byor bskyangs la sogs pa yod par grag na/ de dag gang na bzhugs dris pas/ de dag 'das nas med zer ro/ /'o na de rnams kyi slob ma mkhas pa su yod byas pas/ kun dga' snying po bya ba 'tsho ba bsod snyoms la brten nas nags khrod du sgrub pa mdzad cing bzhugs pa cig yod zer nas/ nags khrod du 'tshol du byon pas/ slob dpon 'bras chan grang mo rdo leb bsregs pa'i steng du srod cing gsol ba dang mjal te/ bslab pa su rgan dris pas/ slob dpon kun snying bgres par 'dug nas/ phyag byas chos kyi gtam dris pas mgu nas chos zhus pas/ rdo rje dbyings la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug cing dbang bskur nas rgyud dang gdams pa rnams gnang ngo / /des zhus pa'i don du rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje thams cad 'byung ba zhes bya ba mdzad nas de la gnang / des kyang dpe yul dbus su khyer te bshad pa byas pas/

yul dbus kyi paṇ+ḍi ta rnams na re/ 'di lta bu'i chos su la 'dug zer/ des slob dpon ā nan ta gar+bha zhes bya ba bsod nams mdzad cing sgrub pa la brtson pa phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa zhig da lta yang bham̐ ga la na bzhugs so zhes smras pas/ de nas gtam de paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyi snyan nas snyan du brgyud de/ rim gyis rgyal pos kyang thos pas dad de skyes bu dam pa de bsod snyoms mdzad nas gsol ba 'o brgyal bas mchod gnas su spyan drang bar bya'o zer nas shing rta la spyan drangs nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po thams cad dang / rgyal pos chos kyi gnas brtan chen por mnga' gsol byas so/ /de nas rgyal po'i yon sbyang ba'i phyir rnal 'byor gyi rgyud brgya rtsa la 'grel pa mdzad par dgongs te/ o tsa ya na gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang du/ de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa de nyid snang ba zhes bya ba sh+lau ka stong phrag bco brgyad yod pa zhig mdzad de/ o tsa ya nar gtsug nor bu/ /'jig rten gsum po dga' byed pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi gnas/ /dpal ldan gtsug lag khang chen du/ /rgyud kyi 'grel pa de nyid ni/ /snang byed dge ba 'di bshad pas/ /zhes pa dang / grangs la rmongs pa gzhug pa'i phyir/ /gzhung 'di'i grangs kyi tshad dag ni/ /stong phrag dag ni bco brgyad du/ /'gro la phan pa bskyed phyir byas/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /dum bu gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga 'jig rten gsum rgyal 'byung ba zhes bya ba sh+lau ka stong nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga pa mdzad/ de yang 'grel chen gyi sngon du mdzad pa yin te/ 'grel chen las/ ji skad bshad pa'i tshul gyi zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dum bu gsum dang bzhi pa ni 'grel chen nang nyid du dkyil 'khor rgyas par gsungs pas logs par ma bstan to/ /rdo rje 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i gzhung tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu pa dang /

rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba rdor sems rnal 'byor gcig ldan la brten pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnam gsum bsgom pa'i bsnyen pa'i cho ga tshul bsdus pa dang rgyas pa gnyis mdzad de/ sems dpa' 'byung chen 'byung chung du grags so/ /rgyal po'i murdza'i gnas su dpal mchog gi 'grel pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'byung ba zhes bya ba stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga pa mdzad de/ lha yi dbang po'i gnas dang mtshungs/ /rgyal po murdza'i gnas kyis mdzes/ /sngags shes rin chen tshogs pa'i sa/ /sna tshogs brtsegs pa nyams dga'i ri/ /der gnas dpal ldan mchog dang po'i/ /shes rab pha rol phyin 'byung ba'i/ /bshad pa bdag gis byas pa la/ /zhes dang / 'di yi tshad du bshad pa ni/ /stong phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang rnam par snang mdzad sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang / ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa stong phrag bcu gnyis pa dang / de'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i cho ga la sogs pa mdzad de/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud brgya rtsa brgyad la 'grel pa mdzad ces grags so/ /'ga' zhig rnal 'byor gyi rgyud brgya brgyad ma rnyed par dpal mchog lta bu'i rgyud sde re re la'ang 'grel pa che ba chung ba gnyis gnyis mdzad zer la bu ston rin po ches/ de ni mi bden de dpal mchog gi 'grel pa chung ba 'di slob dpon gyis mdzad pa ma yin te/ de dang grub mtha' mi mthun pa'i phyir 'di ni slob dpon pad+ma lcags kyus mdzad par sems te/ de dang grub mtha' mthun par snang ngo zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar che ba'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i slob dpon kun dga' snying po'i dngos slob pradzñā wa li ta nas/ pradzñā bo ti mu ri ṣa ko sha dharma pha la rnams la rim par brgyud de 'phags yul du dar ba'i lugs ni lam srol chen po gcig yin la/

lugs 'di la mu ti ṣa ko shas mdzad pa'i 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi 'grel pa dang / slob dpon ye shes dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i sher phyin gyi tshul brgya lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa dang / rab zhi bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i mnyam sbyar gyi 'grel pa dang / yo ga rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi 'grel pa la sogs gzhung 'grel mang du yod par bshad do/ /yang lo rgyus gzhan las/ slob dpon chen po bud+dha gup+ta zhes bya ba shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa gcig gis dgon pa pa lo bdun mdzad nas sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs shing phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes te/ des de nyid bsdus pa dang / rdo rje rtse mo dang / dpal mchog dang po dang / ngan song sbyong rgyud dang / rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa dang lnga'i dbang dang gdams pa thams cad 'jam dpal las dngos su thob nas/ yan lag rdo rje la bshad/ des grub pa'i rdo rje la/ des 'jam pa'i nga ro la/ des dpe med rdo rje la/ des warti ka badz+ra la/ des khu byug rdo rje la/ des pad+ma'i rdo rje myu gu la/ des rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti phyi ma la/ de'i snang ba'i rdo rje la/ des u rgyan gyi bu mo gsang ba'i rdo rje ma la bshad de/ de ni sgrol ma'i sprul bar yang grags/ des yul o de sha'i rgyal po bi su bskal pa la des yul dbus kyi rgyal rigs sa ra ha la bshad de/ des 'jam dpal gyi zhal mthong zhing sprul par yang grags so/ /des nyi ma'i snying po la dang / rdo rje dri med gnyis la bshad/ de nas brgyud pa lugs gnyis su gyes te/ nyi ma'i snying pos kun dga' snying po dang / zla ba grags pa dang / grub pa'i mar me mdzad bzang po dang / bir+ya mi tra dang / rab 'byor bskyangs dang lnga la bshad nas/ grong khyer kong ka na'i ri bo grags thob sa na ta zhes bya ba la sgrub pa mdzad pas/ yo ga'i sgo nas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes so/

/des rjes su yang 'jam dpal grags pa/ dbang phyug dpal 'dus/ gtsug tor rdo rje/ blo gros brtan pa/ blo gros 'byung gnas/ u rgyan gyi dge slong yon tan 'byung gnas dang drug la bshad de/ nyi ma'i snying po las brgyud pa bcu gcig tu gyes so/ /sa ra ha'i slob ma rdo rje dri med kyis grub pa'i ye shes zhabs la/ des grong khyer bzang po'i slob dpon sangs rgyas sde zhes bya ba la gnang ste de yang mkhas shing grub pa thob pa zhig yin par grags so/ /de nyid slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen zhes bya bas dad pas mnyes par byas nas gnang ba mnos shing dbang dang dam tshig thob nas rgyud mang du gsan no/ /de nas grong khyer kong ka ner tra mi tra dang / dbang phyug dpal 'dus dang / chos kyi sde dang / chos kyi 'byung gnas rnams la bsnyen bkur te rgyud don man ngag zhus so/ /de nas grong khyer sa h+yer slob dpon chos kyi rdo rje dang / gtsug tor rdo rje bsnyen bkur nas legs par gsan zhing / de rjes byang phyogs u rgyan gyi yul du rgyal po chen po in+d+ra bhu ti legs par bsten nas rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa legs par zhus so/ /de nas yul raka kyer grong khyer ka la sha'i slob dpon blo brtan dang blo gros 'byung gnas gnyis bsten nas rgyud dbang man ngag dang bcas pa la mkhas par bslabs so/ /de ltar bla ma bcu'i man ngag la brten nas rgyud kyi tshig don la mkhas par gyur pa yin te/ ko sa la'i rgyan las/ grong khyer bzang por sangs rgyas sde zhes grags thob gang / /bla ma'i mchog de dang por rab dad mnyes byas te/ /gnang ba mnos shing cho gas dam tshig thob nas ni/ /de las shin tu mang thos mang du rnam par spyad/ /kong ka ner tra mi tra dbang phyug dpal 'dus dang / /chos sde chos kyi 'byung gnas dga' bas bsnyen bkur byas/ /sa h+yer chos kyi rdo rje mchog tu mtshan gsol ba/

/gtsug tor rdo rje'ang mang du bsnyen bkur byas/ /yon tan 'byung gnas byang phyogs u rgyan yul bgrod de/ /rgyud don de nyid 'dzin rgyal in+d+ra bhu ti bsten/ /grong khyer rag kyer ka la sha yi slob dpon ni/ /blo brtan blo gros 'byung nas tshul mkhas gus pas bsten/ /bla ma'i zhal las yang dag man ngag gang las ni/ /cung zad bdag gis ci rtogs gang dag dag pa'i tshul/ /'jig rten rnal 'byor cho gas slob dpon bzhin rim gyis/ /'di ni yun ring gnas phyir bdag gis rnam par bsam/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i slob dpon des thun mong gi dngos grub thob par grags so/ /des yul gaṇ+ḍo ko sa lar dpal ldan bde byed kyis byas pa'i gtsug lag khang na/ rgyal po dpa' bo zhes bya bas sbyin bdag mdzad nas gnas pa'i tshe/ grogs gnas brtan dbang po'i go chas bskul zhing slob ma shes rab lha'i don du/ de nyid bsdus pa'i rgya cher bshad pa sh+lau ka stong phrag bcu gnyis pa mdzad de/ mtshan yang ko sa la'i rgyan du grags so/ /de ltar yang 'grel pa de nyid las/ yon tan mang ldan dad pa mchog gi gnas gyur gaṇ+ḍo sngon 'gro ko sa lar/ /dge zhing tshul mang legs pa rgya mtsho dang ldan gtsug lag khang mchog de/ /dpal ldan bde byed kyis byas shin tu yid 'ongs mkhas pa rnams kyi gnas gyur cing / /rgyal po'i dpa' bo chos kyi bdag nyid dpal gyi kha ba bzhin bsil der gnas so/ /dang por grogs mchog gnas brtan dbang po go chas tshig gis gsol ba btab pa dang / /shes rab lha yi mkhas bcas brtson pa'i stobs sogs gtso bor byas la bsten pa dang / /bde gshegs bstan la 'gro ba 'di dag nyon mongs dbang song mthong ba dang / /skyon med gsang sngags don yang gzhan dbang song bas gzhan du kun tu sbyor bar gyur/ /de phyir nges don shin tu rnam 'byed tshig don gsal zhing kun gyi thun mong ba'i/ /rgya cher bshad 'di 'gro ba'i don kun sgrub phyir shākya'i mi tras sa steng brtsams/

/zhes gsungs so/ /yang dang po'i slob dpon 'jam dpal gyi grub thob de dang ming mtshungs pa'i slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas dang po thos pa ma mdzad par/ bal yul du ut+pal phung po gcig dang / ba dmar ser gyi mar skyogs gang dang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sku ras bris gcig dang gsum bzhag te bsgrubs pa las/ dus nam zhig na me tog kyang kha bye/ mar yang khol/ ras bris kyang bzhad pa mthong ba las/ slob dpon gyis dngos grub len ma mkhyen te/ mar btung ngam me tog dbul lam go rim gang yin rtog par gyur pa las/ rtog pa de gegs su gyur te/ gnod sbyin mo phag sha 'gram zhes bya bas slob dpon gyi 'gram pa la thal lcag bsnun pas slob dpon brgyal bar gyur to/ /de nas brgyal pa sangs tsa na rnying pa dang / bo ba dang / sku la rdul gyis gos par gyur to/ /de nas mar 'thung / me tog phul/ sku rdul phyis nas bzhugs so/ /de ltar gyur kyang dngos grub phra mo thob ste/ shes rab shin tu rno bar gyur nas/ e ma bdag ltar thos pa chung ba yang bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o gsungs nas/ grong khyer mnyan yod ces bya bar slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i rdo rje myu gu zhabs la gsan pa rgya cher mdzad pas mkhyen rab kyi phul du gyur te/ grong khyer ser skya'i nags khrod du bzhugs nas 'grel pa la yang btags/ mang du gsungs pa las g.yeng bar gzigs nas/ e ma bdag ltar thos pa che ba yang bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o gsungs nas pu hrang du byon te/ gangs ti se'i drung du sgrub pa mdzad pas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes so/ /de ltar na grub chen kun dga' snying po zhes pa za hor gyi mkhas pa chen po dang / sa ra ha'i slob ma nyi ma'i snying po dang / rdo rje dri med gnyis las phyi ma'i slob brgyud shākya bshes gnyen dang / 'jam dpal las dngos su gdams pa thob par grags pa slob dpon bud+dha gup+ta zhes bya ba'i slob brgyud/

rgyal chen in+d+ra bhu ti phyi ma'i bla ma/ slob dpon pad+ma'i rdo rje myu gu zhes pa'i slob ma slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba dang gsum la yo ga la mkhas pa'i mi gsum zhes grags pa yin la/ de yang tshig la mkhas pa kun dga' snying po/ don la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba/ tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas pa shākya bshes gnyen zhes bya zhing / bu ston rin po che'i gsung las/ don la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba/ tshig la mkhas pa shākya bshes gnyen/ tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas pa kun dga' snying po zhes sam/ rig pa la mkhas pa shākya bshes gnyen/ man ngag la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba/ gnyis ka'i sgo nas lag len la mkhas pa kun dga' snying po ste mkhas pa'i mi gsum du grags so zhes 'byung la/ de ltar gsum las phyi ma kun dga' snying po'i mched grogs slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal grags pa ni che ba'i yon tan lnga dang ldan te/ dang por rigs kyi che ba ni 'jig rten pa'i rigs kyi mchog rgyal po'i rigs yin la/ de yang rgya gar lho phyogs su laṅga yul/ grong khyer chen po seng ge'i gdong pa zhes bya ba'i bye brag grong khyer dpal 'byung ba zhes bya bar/ yab rgyal po sa ha dha na zhes bya ba'am/ zla 'od ces kyang bya zhing / yum bram ze mo dga' ba'i blo gros kyi bu mo me tog ldan zhes bya ba'i sras su/ khye'u mtshan dang ldan pa phyag g.yas pa'i mthil na ral gri'i mtshan ma yod pa/ smin ma sngon po can shin tu yid du 'ongs pa zhig btsas par gyur to zhes grags shing / yang lo rgyus kha cig las/ yab rgyal po sa ha dha na dang / yum pa ta lo ma la zhes bya ba la bu med par gyur nas/ gtsug lag khang khar+sa pa ṇir dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa phul te/ dam pa nye bar brtse ba rnams/ /kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /rgyud kyi sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bu yi mchog gcig stsal du gsol/ /'jig rten gdung ba sangs pa'i bu/

/pha ma sems can thams cad la/ /brtse bar sems dpa'i blo gros can/ /'dren pa'i lcags kyus btsal bar shog /ces gsol ba btab pas/ de nas zla ba gsum lon pa na rgyal po'i rmi lam du bu gcig btsas par rmis te gnyid sad pa na khye'u gzugs bzang ba mtshan dang ldan pa gcig rang nyid kyi pang na 'dug pa mthong nas ngo mtshar skyes te/ khyod su yin zhes gsungs pas/ khye'u na re/ kye/ bdag ni khyod kyis smon pa'i bu mchog ste/ /stobs chen 'jam dpal grags pa zhes bya yin/ /mngal gyi dri mas bdag la mi gos te/ /bdag ni sprul 'dra sems can mgon du 'ongs/ /yab yum dgyes shing sems can mthar phyin bya/ /legs par yab yum gnyis la mngon par 'dud/ nyi ma lta bu'i snying rjes gzhan bsgral bya/ /zhes tshigs su bcad de smras pa dang / pha ma gnyis kyis kye gling gi mchog 'di la bu khyod lta bu gzhan dag yod dam/ 'on te khyod gcig pu yin zhes smras pas/ de na re/ kyai yab yum gnyis shar phyogs bham̐ ga la'i grong khyer chen po kam+pa la zhes bya ba na rgyal po ka ma ri zhes bya ba dang / yum zla ba'i seng ge zhes pa la nga dang 'dra ba'i sras phyag na rdo rje zhes bya ba zhig btsas par gyur to/ /gtsug lag khang mahā bho dhi zhes bya ba'i rtsar/ rgyal po ta ma la zhes bya dang / yum nī la at+pal zhes bya la nga dang 'dra ba'i sras 'jig rten dbang phyug ces bya ba btsas par gyur to/ /de yang / sems bskyed rtsa ba gcig pa'i mthus/ /legs slob dge slong bzang dge ba/ /thun mong ma yin sbyor ba'i mthus/ /dpa' bo dbang phyug stobs mi zad/ /zhi gyur 'khor lo chen po'i mthus/ /sa yi dbang phyug chos dbang can/ /don mthus 'jig rten gnas su 'ongs/ /mngon dga' mi la gsang ba ston/ /zhes smras so/ /de nas yab yum gyis gtsang ma'i mchod pa bzang pos mchod de bsnyen bkur ba dang / lo sum cu gnyis kyi bar du lo brgyad pa'i cha byad 'dzin par gnas pa dang /

yab kyis/ khyod gzhon nur gyur pa ji lta bu yin gsungs pa la/ skye mched chos kyi sku la bgres mi mnga'/ /lus ngag yid gsum skyon bral 'jam pa ste/ /bdag gzhan don 'dzin khyad par dpal du gyur/ /de yi rtags su gzhon nu lo brgyad lon/ /sa brgyad dang mthus mi g.yo ba la gnas/ /legs par 'ongs la bdag ni byang chub sems/ /zhes gsungs pas sprul pa'i sku dang brdzus skyes su bshad pa 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa sbyangs pa mkhyen pa'i yon tan ni/ des gzhon nu'i dus su bram ze lha'i dbang po zhes bya ba dang / rgyal rigs nyi ma'i blo gros la sgra rig pa bslabs te/ lobs pa dang sgra thams cad kyi don bsdus bya ka ra na bsdus pa'i don gyi bstan bcos shes bya ma mdzad do/ /de nas gtan tshigs rig pa bslabs te mthar phyin pa dang rtog ge rnam par dpyad pa zhes bya ba bam po lnga pa mdzad do/ /de nas bzo rig pa thams cad bslabs pas mthar phyin pa dang / sgyu rtsal gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba mdzad do/ /de nas tsi ra ka pa chen po dang / drang srong gi tshe'i rig 'dzin yan lag brgyad pa gtso bor byas te/ gso ba rigs pa thams cad bslabs te/ mthar phyin pa dang bde gsum gsal ba zhes bya ba mdzad do/ /de nas gsum pa rab tu byung ba sde pa'i yon tan ni/ mkhan po chen po bha bya legs ldan 'byed las rab tu byung ste/ rtsa ba'i sde pa bzhi las dge 'dun phal chen sde pa'i lugs su zhugs so/ /bzhi pa sgrub pa grub pa'i yon tan ni/ spyir bla ma bdun yod pa'i mchog tu gyur pa'i gsum/ klu sgrub dang / dzñā na pa dang / bha ba'i lha dang de gsum gyi rjes su 'brangs nas nang rig pa thams cad ma lus pa bslabs te/ de nas dpal dzñā na pa'i gdams pa la brten nas 'phags pa 'jam mgon bsgrubs pas/ lha de'i byin gyis brlabs shing zhal mthong ba dang gsung thos pa yin te/ slob dpon nyid kyi lta ba rnam par nges pa'i mdo 'grel las/

bde gshegs dgongs pa zab mo'i tshul/ /bdag gis dbye bar nus min yang / /mgon po'i mthu stobs blo gros brten/ /de yi gsung rab rnam par phye/ /zhes pa dang / snying po rgyan las/ dri med lus med ces sogs gsungs so/ /lnga pa rtogs pa lta ba'i yon tan ni/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' bzhi las/ chos thams cad bdag med pa spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i don dbu ma rab tu mi gnas pa rtogs pa'o/ /che ba'i yon tan lnga po de lta bu dang ldan pa des sems can rnams grol bar bya ba'i phyir/ pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad gsal bar byed pa/ gsung rab bcu gnyis kyi rab tu dbye ba zhes kyang bya/ sde snod gsal bar byed pa zhes kyang bya ba'i bstan bcos mdzad do/ /sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis ka'i thun mong du lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa lta ba ngan pa'i mdo 'grel bam po dgu pa mdzad do/ /grub pa'i mtha' sna tshogs gsal bar byed pa mtshan brjod 'grel pa chen po rnal 'byor chen po'i snying po'i don gsal bar byed pa rgya cher 'grel/ de la phan par byed pa'i yan lag tu snying po rgyan/ gzhan yang bka' dang bstan bcos du ma gsal bar mdzad do/ /des rgyal po'i rigs su 'khrungs shing 'jig rten dbang phyug gis rjes su bzung ba dpal sbas bzang po la bshad/ des sgrol ma'i rjes su bzung ba'i slob dpon bram ze ye shes rdo rje la bshad/ des rgyal po'i rigs su 'khrungs pa rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas shing na len+t+ra'i nub sgo srung ba shes rab 'byung gnas blo gros dpal la bshad/ des dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi zhal gzigs pa'i bram ze bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang / pad+ma ka ra dang / pra ta ka ra sogs la bshad/ de dag gis 'jam dpal mtshan brjod rnal 'byor rgyud du bkral ba'i 'grel pa chen po nam mkha' dri med che ba'i skor du grags pa rnams dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ yang 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhes bya ba'i mtshan brjod rnal 'byor rgyud du bkral ba'i 'grel pa dang /

rigs bsdus pa dang rigs so so ba'i sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog la sogs pa'i chos skor mang du mdzad cing / sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang / sgeg pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa la bshad do/ /de la sgeg pa'i rdo rje ni gsang mtshan yin la/ de'i mtshan ni dpal ldan byang chub mchog gi skal ba dang ldan pa zhes grags la/ slob dpon byang chub mchog gis rin po che'i gling du byon nas zab mo'i lam gyi sgrub pa mdzad pas 'jam dpal gyi dngos grub brnyes so/ /der mtshan yang nor bu gling pa zhes bya bar grags so/ /de ltar slob dpon de nor bu'i gling du bzhugs pa la/ mu stegs pa gcig nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor pa khyad par can gyi dbang po lnga'am don snying lnga yod na de la brten nas thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i thabs su 'gyur ba nas/ mu stegs kyis nor bu'i gling du slob dpon gsod du phyin pa la/ slob dpon gyis 'phags pa 'jam dpal du sprul nas 'jam dpal de sna tshogs kyi gzugs su ston pa'o zhes bya ba yin pas/ slob dpon gzugs sna tshogs su sprul nas nor bu'i gling der bzhugs pas/ mu stegs pas bsad du ma brnyed par log go /der mtshan sna tshogs gzugs can zhes bya bar grags so/ /thugs rjes gzhan la phan 'dogs pas nyi ma lta bu'i slob dpon zhes bya ba'am/ yang na rin po che'i gling de rang gi gsal bas na nyi ma lta bu zhes gnas las mtshan btags so/ /de lta bu'i slob dpon des sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal la dngos su gsan nas mkhyen no/ /des gzhan don du mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa sngags don rnam gzigs bya ba dang / gsang ldan zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs dang / dkyil chog yon tan 'byung gnas/ mtshan brjod bklags pa'i sgom khog sbyin sreg gi cho ga la sogs pa mang du mdzad do/ /de ltar spyir mtshan brjod la slob dpon zla bzang dpal gyis mdzad pa'i mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa lta bu gsang 'dus dang mthun par bkral ba dang /

slob dpon nyi ma dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa tshigs bcad ma dang / de'i 'grel bshad dpe med mchog gis mdzad pa lta bu dus 'khor dang mthun par bkral ba'i lugs dang / ma cig zha ma'i mtshan brjod kyi bshad srol lta bu lam 'bras dang mthun pa'i lugs te bla med dang mthun par bkral ba'i lugs gsum dang / yo ga dang mthun par bkral ba gsum ste drug yod de/ sdom gsum rab dbye las/ mtshan brjod bshad pa lugs drug dang / /zhes gsungs pa yin la/ yo ga dang mthun pa gsum ni/ gong du bstan pa'i slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang / 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang / sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang gsum gyis mdzad pa'i mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa gsum po de dag yin zhing / de gsum la mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa che chung bar pa dang gsum du grags te/ che ba ni 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ chung ba ni 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ bar pa ni slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'grel pa ste/ dang po de nyid la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sngags kyi tshul gnyis ro gcig par byed pa'i bshad pa zhes bya zhing / 'di nas chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dkyil 'khor sgo gsum sbrags la sgo phyi ma 'jig rten pa'i khor yug la bskyed chog rgyas pa dang bcas pa zhig dang / lha mo bcu la yang sa bcu'i ming ni btags te rab tu dga' ba ma zhes pa'i tha snyad bshad pa yod cing / 'grel pa 'di la nam mkha' dri med thogs med kyang grags pa yin no/ /bar pa de la gsang sngags kyi don la rnam par lta ba zhes pa'i sngags don rnam gzigs zhes bya zhing / 'di nas chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dkyil 'khor ston par bshad/ chung ba rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor lnga/ rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor gcig ston cing / rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor ni/

dbus su 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor la mthar rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyis bskor ba bde mchog 'khor lo rgyud drug gi dkyil 'khor lta bu zhig yod par bshad cing / 'grel pa 'di la nam mkha' dri med chung ba zhes kyang grags pa yin la/ 'di rnams yo gar 'jog pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i yo ga la mkhas pa'i mi gsum du grags pa de dag gi rjes su 'brangs pa yang ma yin zhing / /de rnams dang bshad srol mthun pa yang min mod kyang / 'di rnams nas bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed par ye shes dgug gzhug phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs ci rigs pa bshad pas bya spyod las khyad par du 'phags shing / dbang bzhi dang rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor med pas bla med du 'jog tu mi rung bas rnal 'byor rgyud dang mthun par bkral ba'i lugs su 'jog par bshad pa yin no/ /de ltar mtshan brjod la yo ga dang mthun pa'i 'grel pa gsum du byung ba'i nang gi bar pa sngags don rnam gzigs mdzad pa po slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje sna tshogs gzugs zhes bya ba des/ sūr ya sing ha la gnang / des kyang yul sing ha la zhes bya bar zab mo'i lam gyi sgrub pa mdzad pas 'jam dpal gyi dngos grub brnyes so/ /des dharma badz+ra la bshad/ des rgya ri si ha zhes bya bar sgrub pa mdzad pas dngos grub brnyes so/ /slob dpon de la yang sa her chos kyi rdo rje zhes bya bar grags so/ /des mu tra sid+dhi la bshad/ des rgya ri bya rkang tsan rje bya bar zab mo'i man ngag gi sgrub pa mdzad pas grub pa brnyes so/ /khyad par yang dang po'i sangs rgyas rnon po zhes bya ba grub ste/ gzhan la yang ston nus so/ /des de wa sha ra la bshad do/ /de yan chad du brgyud pa re re las gnyis su ma 'phros so/ /de nas de wa sha ra la slob ma shan+tiṃ gar+bha dang / smṛ ti dzñā na'o/ /shan+tiṃ gar+bhas ri bo rtse lnga la sgrub pa mdzad pas dngos grub brnyes so/

/des nyi ma'i dngos grub la bshad/ des sgrub pa mdzad pas mi rnams kyis ci yin mi rtogs te/ tha ma nyi zla kha sbyor gyi nang du sgrub pa mdzad ces grag go /nyi ma'i zer la sgrub pa mdzad pas nyi ma'i dngos grub ces grags so/ /de lta bu'i slob dpon rnams kyis mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa bar pa'i skor rnams dar bar mdzad do/ /de rnams ni rgya gar dbus dang / nub phyogs kha che sogs su dar ba'i tshul te de dag gis ni 'phags yul du rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lam srol ji ltar byung ba'i tshul bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa bod yul du dar ba'i tshul la/ bstan pa snga dar gyi tshe ji ltar dar ba'i tshul dang / phyi dar gyi tshe ji ltar dar ba'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ spyir rgyal khrims rnam dag la brten chos kyi khrims 'byung ba yin pas/ de yang rje btsun rin po che grags pa'i gsung las/ bod kyi rgyal po khri bdun ldeng cig dang / /legs drug lde brgyad btsan bzhi zhes bya ste/ /nyi shu rtsa drug sngon gyi rgyal rabs yin/ /skyid pa'i rgyal rabs phyed dang bcu dang ni/ /shin tu skyid pa'i rgyal rab phyed dang bzhi/ /de ltar gdung rabs bzhi bcu tham pa ste/ /de yi bod 'bangs spyi yi skyid de 'khor/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bod kyi rgyal po'i thog ma gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung ba'i rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa drug 'das pa nyi shu rtsa bdun pa lha tho tho ri snyan btsan gyi ring la dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga na srong btsan sgam po byon/ rgyal po de'i ring la gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ dam pa'i chos bsgyur ba sogs kyi sgo nas chos kyi srol gtod/ de nas mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan byon/ chos rgyal des mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho dang / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs pa spyan drangs te gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ de gong du btsun pa sad mi mi bdun la sogs pa rab tu byung ste/

rnam dag khrims khang gling du khrims phog sngar dbang bskur med pa la slob dpon pad+ma la sogs pas dbang bskur te/ de nas bzung bdud 'dul sngags pa gling du gsang sngags skyong / dga' ldan sems bskyed gling du byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed dang sdom pa phog ste/ bod du chos dar bar byas so/ /de'i tshe na slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba mnga' ris dang mang yul gyi cha na sgrub pa mdzad cing bzhugs par grags te/ de rgyal pos gsan te blon po dbas mañdzu shrī dang / brang kha mu di ta go cha/ chim shākya pra bha wa dang gsum spyan 'dren du btang bas/ slob dpon gyis yi dam gyi lha la lung bstan zhus pas/ phyin na tshe'i bar chad du 'gyur bar dgongs nas ma byon par/ nga yis phyin pa dang 'dra ba zhig bya yi gsungs nas sgrub thabs kyi tshad rnam par bzhag pa rgyud kyi don la 'jug pa zhes bya ba rdor dbyings kyi sgrub thabs mdzad/ bsdus 'grel gyi tshad rnam par gzhag pa rnam snang mngon byang gi don bsdus mdzad/ rgya cher 'grel kyi tshad rnam par gzhag pa bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgya cher 'grel dang gsum mdzad nas bskur/ rgyal po la zhal ta'i springs yig bod kyi chos pa rnams la zhal ta'i springs yig sogs gnang ste de yang / bod kyi spur rgyal mgo nag yongs kyi rje/ /khri srong lde btsan ag tshom mes kyi sras/ /dgung rnams 'phrul gyi rgyal po'i dbon po yis/ /srong btsan sgam po spyan ras gzigs kyi sku/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sku rgyun gdung ma chad/ /'gro drug nang na shes rig che ba'i mi/ /dug lnga sdong po rgyud drug kun gyi gzhi/ /khri rje thog btsan man chad rgyud ma yi/ /dge ba bcu khrims bcas nas dul bar mdzad/ /rigs kyi sprul pa khri srong lde btsan gyis/ /'gro ba yi ni skar khung dbye slad du/ /rgya gar yul gyi rdo rje gdan steng du/ /sde snod gsum po shākya thub pas gsungs/
