lan cig rde'u bkram nas chos shes pa rnams brjed dam ma brjed gsad pa'i ma brjed 'dug pas 'dzum shor/ thengs shig sa phug na nyal ba'i tshe g.yu mtsho'i mtsho sman mos 'o ma gnyan 'jo gang 'bul du byung ba na phyag byas pas 'o ma bo nas skyengs te phyi 'gros byas te song bas rgod bro ba zhig byung gsungs so/ /de nas de'i tshe dpyal ser tshab paṇ+ḍi ta 'tshol du byon pas/ khyongs rje sha tshag gi sgo gong du/ ri bong 'dzin pa rgyu skar phreng ba can/ /mtshan mo mkha' la rgyu ba rnam spangs nas/ /dwangs pa'i chu nang 'di na zla ba zhes/ /dbyibs la mtshan mar 'dzin pa byis pa'i blo/ /zhes bris 'dug pa la mthong nas 'di sus bris byas pas/ a pho rnyed legs kyis bris zer/ de gar song dris pas lug 'tsho ru song zer/ de 'tshol du phyin pas 'phrad/ gcig gis gcig la 'khyud nas bshum/ de nas sman lung du gdan drangs nas bod skad sbyangs te chos mang du gsungs/ de'i tshe paṇ+ḍi ta shi ba gcig gi rgya dpe lus pa yin nam zer/ khong rang gi rgya dpe rnams 'khor ba yin nam yang zer ba'i rgya dpe po ti gcig gnyis tsam byung ste/ de'i nang gi mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa sngags don rnam gzigs/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa gsang ba dang ldan pa'i sgrub thabs/ mtshan brjod bklags pa'i bsgom khog rim gnyis kyis phye ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rgyas pa/ dkyil chog yon tan 'byung ba ste sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i chos lngar grags pa rnams la sogs pa yig cha mang po zhig smṛrti nyid kyis rang 'gyur mdzad do/ /dbang bka' bshad bka' sogs tshong sde ngag gi dbang phyug la gnang / de nyid la yul pu hrang ba chung ngu nas khams phyogs su 'khyams te der yun ring pas khams pa shes rab rdo rje zhes grags pa des zhus/ de nas bar skabs shig mtshan brjod kyi dpe rnams 'khyams te/ jo bo skyid bye ma lung pa'i phyag tu byung ste/

khong mtshan brjod la shin tu mos pas 'di shes pa zhig byung na snyam/ gar 'gror dpe bsnams te pu hrang du yo ga slob tu byon pa'i tshe/ shan+ti gar+bha'i slob ma paṇ+ḍi ta sur+ya sid+dhi ste nyi ma'i dngos grub dang mjal te/ chos ci shes byas pas mtshan brjod shes zer/ su'i lugs yin byas pas sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i lugs yin zer/ de sngar nas 'gyur yod byas pas/ sus bsgyur zer/ smṛrtis bsgyur byas pas/ khong mkhas pa chen po yin/ nga'i bla ma'i grogs po yin zer nas thal mo sbyar/ der khong gis paṇ+ḍi ta la gsang ldan cha lag dang bcas pa zhus/ 'gyur bcos zhus pa ma gnang / zhu dag tsam mdzad ces grags so/ /de nas khong gis paṇ+ḍi ta de la dbang bka' sogs thob nas stod lung bye ma lung du byon te bzhugs yod pa na/ rngog jo sras chos rdor bya bas der byon te dbang bka' sogs zhus/ mtshan brjod la nga bas mkhas pa med snyam pa tsam sbyangs/ dus der khams pa shes rab rdo rje bya ba dbus gtsang du byon nas skyi chos ye la yang gsang ldan gyi skor gsan/ pu hrang du byon nas paṇ+ḍi ta nyi ma'i dngos grub la yang gsan nas mkhas par sbyangs so/ /der skabs shangs kyi sum ston ye 'bar sngags la sgra che bas rngog gis der yo ga nyan du phyin pas/ shangs pa'i chos grwa der btsun pa chos gos hrul le ba gyon pa dpe cha rta khal theg tshad bkal ba dpon g.yog gnyis dang 'phrad de/ rngog gis dge bshes kyis ci shes byas pas/ mtshan brjod shes zer/ der bgro gleng byas pas khong rgyal/ man ngag 'gran pas kyang khong che bar byung / brgyud pa brtsis pas khong smṛrtis brgyud pa khams pa shes rab rdo rje bya bar 'dug pas/ rngog gis de skabs shangs pa la chos ma zhus par yul du log khams pa lo gcig bsten nas mtshan brjod la sogs pa mang du zhus/ zhabs tog cher byas so/ /de ltar rngog la bka' babs pa'i smṛrti nas brgyud pa la smad lugs dang /

nyi ma'i dngos grub nas brgyud pa la stod lugs zhes grags so/ /de ltar na bod du bstan pa phyi dar la yo ga'i lam srol grags che ba gsum tsam byung bar bshad de/ dang po ni lo chen rin bzang gis sangs rgyas zhi ba dang / shra dha ka ra warma la gsan pa'i srol mnga' ris stod kyi lo chung sogs dang / smad kyi slob ma nyang stod kyi lce zhar/ bo dong gi spang kha 'dar chung / nyang stod kyi rkyang po chos blo/ rin spungs kyi sum ston ye 'bar/ g.yag sde lung gi gnyen ston tshul 'bar sogs kyis sa cha smad du dar bar byas te/ rma ban chos 'bar/ rong pa chos mgon sogs nas/ bu ston lugs kyi bar byung ba rnams ni lo chen gyi sku tshe'i stod la byung ba'i srol yin kyang sa cha smad du dar bar smad lugs zhes bya ba'i khongs su gtogs pa rnams so/ /lam srol gnyis pa ni/ lo chen gyi sku tshe'i smad la kha che dharma pha la la zhus nas phyag len shin tu dag par mdzad pa'i slob ma brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ skyi thang pa dzñā na shrī/ gur shing pa brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan sogs kyis sa cha stod du dar bar byas pa rnams so/ /gsum pa ni/ jo bo rje bod du byon dus go mi bsgom chen gyis kun rig sogs zhus nas/ kyi nor dzñā na/ snyal pa nyi ma shes rab/ snur nyi ma shes rab/ snur nyi ma 'od zer/ rtsa skya pa/ 'dzim pa sogs brgyud nas dar ba rnams ni kun rig sogs jo bo nas brgyud kyang / yo ga gzhan rnams lo chen gyi sku tshe'i smad kyi srol ltar yin par bshad cing / de ltar yin kyang sa cha stod du dar bas na stod lugs kyi khongs su 'du bar bshad do/ /gzhan yang zangs dkar lo tsā bas kha che dzñā na shrī la gsan nas spel ba de nyid dang / da na shi la'i slob ma g.yag sde ze dmar bas/ bi bhu ta tsaṇ+ḍa la gsan pa dang / chag lo tsā bas bal po ra wan tra la gsan pa'i kun rig gi dbang bka' dang /

cho ga tsam byung yang lag len sa lugs dang 'dra bas stod lugs sam jo bo'i lugs dang cha 'dra bar gsungs so/ /de ltar sngon gyi dus su srol mang po byung na yang / deng sang gangs can gyi khrod na yod pa'i spyir yo ga dang / bye brag kun rig thams cad lo chen gyi brgyud pa'i yo ga stod lugs dang smad lugs gang rung du 'du dgos shing / de gnyis gang yang ma yin pa'i dge ldan pa'i kun rig sogs ni sbyong rgyud dang mi mthun pas rang bzo yin par bshad do/ /yo ga stod lugs dang / smad lugs gnyis kyi tha snyad 'di la/ mkhas mchog rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi gzhan phan 'khrul sel las/ shra dha nas brgyud pa'i kha che mkhan po'i lugs dang / dharma pha lar gsan pa'i rgya gar shar phyogs pa'i lugs zhes pa'i tha snyad 'thad kyi/ yo ga stod lugs dang smad lugs zhes pa'i tha snyad rje btsun gong mas bshad pa med cing / sangs rgyas zhi ba ni lo chen dang phyi mo nas mjal ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta yin gyi/ sku tshe stod kyi bla ma gtan nas ma yin zhes gsungs la/ rje btsun rin po che'i rdo rje 'byung ba'i ṭik+kar/ jo bo chen po sku tshe stod kyi bshad pa kha che mkhan po las brgyud pa'i lugs ni zhes sogs dang / sku tshe smad rgya gar shar phyogs nas brgyud de zhes sogs gsungs pas/ kha che lugs dang / rgya gar shar phyogs lugs gnyis 'byed pa gzhir bcas mod/ stod lugs dang smad lugs gnyis su phye ba la yang 'gal ba med de lo chen nas brgyud pa'i yo ga la/ sa cha stod mnga' ris phyogs su dar ba/ smad dbus gtsang gi phyogs su dar ba'i yo ga'i srol gnyis su byung bas so/ /'on kyang stod lugs dang smad lugs gnyis sa cha stod smad du dar ba'i sgo nas 'jog pa rje btsun gong ma bzhed pa rang dka' bar snang ste/ rje btsun rin po ches lo chen gyi sku tshe stod smad kyi lugs tsam zhig gsungs kyi/ sa cha stod smad du dar ba'i sgo nas stod lugs dang smad lugs kyi tha snyad ma bshad pas so/

/des na sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rgyun sgra tshad pa dkon mchog rgya mtshos bris pa las/ deng sang stod lugs smad lugs kyi khyad par sa cha stod du dar ba dang / smad du dar ba la 'jog kyang / rje btsun gyi dgongs pa ni kha che mkhan po'i lugs lo chen gyi sku tshe'i stod la babs pa dang / rgya gar shar phyogs dharma pha la'i lugs sku tshe'i smad la babs pa rnams yin par bzhed la/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rje btsun gong ma'i dgongs pa lo chen gyi sku tshe'i stod kyi bshad srol dang / sku tshe'i smad kyi bshad srol gnyis zhes pa tsam zhig gsungs pa 'di yin zhing / bshad srol gnyis kyi dang po de sa cha smad du gtso bor dar bas smad lugs dang / gtso cher sa cha stod du dar ba la brten nas stod lugs zhes pa'i tha snyad phyis su bu ston rin po che sogs kyis 'dogs par mdzad dam snyam ste/ des mdzad pa'i yo ga'i chos 'byung rnal 'byor gru gzings las/ shar phyogs pa'i rjes 'brangs de phyin chad rnams la yo ga gsar ma'am stod lugs zhes grags zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar spyir yo ga la rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du yang lugs srol mi 'dra ba mang du byung zhing / bod kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir yang shin tu mang ba zhig yod pa las/ 'phags yul pa rnams las kun snying lugs/ bod yul pa rnams las lo chen gyi sku tshe'i smad du byung ba'i dharma pha la'i lugs 'di khyad par du 'phags shing / de la yang mang du yod pa'i nang nas deng sang bod 'dir bka' yod cing lhad med pa la phyag len dang bshad pa gnyis ka'i sgo nas dar rgyas su bzhugs pa ni dpal ldan ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud 'di nyid de/ rgyud 'di nas 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug ste bcu gnyis/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi dkyil 'khor bzhi dang bcu drug ro sreg gi dkyil 'khor dang bcu bdun gsungs la/

de dag gsungs pa'i dgos pa ji ltar zhe na/ spyir sbyong rgyud 'di nyid las thugs chos nyid las ma g.yos pa'i rtags su dkyil 'khor bstan/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i rtags su sbyin sreg bstan pa yin la/ de yang bden pa gnyis dang mi 'gal ba'i ched du dkyil 'khor la yang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis gsungs/ dngos por zhen pa bzlog pa dang / thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa mtshon pa'i ched du ro sreg gi sbyin sreg dang / las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gnyis gsungs/ de dag gi go rim la thugs chos nyid las ma g.yos kyang rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems su 'dus pa'i rtags su rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems su 'dus kyang thugs rjes ngan song gi sdug bsngal gzhom pa'i phyir shākya thub pa'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ de ltar rgyu 'bras bcom yang glo bur rkyen gyis 'chi bas de bzlog pa'i ched du phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ glo bur gyi rkyen gyis mi 'chi yang sngon gyi las kyis 'chi bas de bzlog pa'i ched du tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor gsungs la tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob na sngon las kyi 'chi ba yang bzlog nus pa'i lo rgyus ni/ spyir lha dang lha ma yin 'thab pa'i rgyu gnyis te/ dpag bsam gyi shing lha ma yin gyi yul na skyes nas 'bras bu lha rnams la yod pas de la 'thab pa dang / yang lha rnams ni bu sring la 'dod pa mi spyod cing / lha ma yin gyi bu mo bkug nas spyod pas de la yang 'thab bo/ /de yang lha'i dpon ni phur bu yin la/ lha ma yin gyi dpon ni pa ba sangs yin zhing / gnyis ka la dmag bye ba phrag sa ya re yod pa las/ lha'i dpon phur bus rtsis las mi shes pas dmag shi ba rnams gsor ma thub/ lha ma yin gyi dpon pa ba sangs ni sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi dge bshes yin pas 'chi bdag zhi ba'i rig pa 'grub pas lha ma yin shi ba la btab pas dmag nyung du ma song ngo /

/der lha rnams kyis gros byas te/ phur bu'i bu gza' bkrag mdzes bya ba lha min gyi yul du khu bo la mi 'chi ba'i rig pa slob tu btang ba na/ skrag mdzes 'dod 'jo'i ba 'tsho bar btang pa dang / pa ba sangs lha min gyi myos 'gyur gyi chang gis rtag par myos pa nas rig pa slob ma khom par yod pa las/ skrag mdzes kyis mi 'chi ba'i rig pa bslab pa'i ched du rig pa lob nas bu mo lha yul du khrid par byas te/ pa ba sangs gi bu mo ring pha spun mo la chags pa spyad/ de nas lha min gyis skrag mdzes mi 'chi ba'i rig pa slob par rig nas/ gros byas te ba 'tsho sar skrag mdzes bsad/ bu mos ro tshags byas te/ nangs par pha myos pa sangs pa na ming po skrag mdzes byas gyin ngus pa na/ pha na re ci nyes zer/ ming po lha ma yin gyis bsad byas pas/ ro yod dam zer/ bu mos ro yod byas pas/ der phas ro la mi 'chi ba'i rig pa btab pas shi ba las gsos/ de nas yang sngar ltar khu bo myos 'gyur gyi chang gis myos shing / skrag mdzes ba 'tsho ru btang bas rig pa ma lob par/ ba 'tsho sar skrag mdzes lha ma yin rnams kyis bsad de ro ri rab kyi 'og gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar du sbas pas/ yang bu mo'i pha bzi ba sangs pa na ming po skrag mdzes zer zhing ngus pas/ pha na re/ ro yod dam zer/ med byas pas/ phas lha'i mig gis phyi snod 'jig rten na phar bltas pas ri rab kyi 'og na ro 'dug pa mthong nas/ bu mo'i yid 'gyogs par byed pa'i gzungs 'grub pas ro blangs/ phas mi 'chi ba'i rig pa btab pas gsos/ de nas kyang rig pa ma lob par ba 'tsho ba yi yod pa na/ yang lha ma yin rnams kyis bsad de ro de tshogs par byas nas pa ba sangs rang la drangs pas/ yang bu mos pha myos pa sangs pa dang / ming po skrag mdzes byas ngus pas/ ro yod dam zer ba la med byas pas/ pa ba sangs kyi lha'i mig gis phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la bltas pas kyang ma rnyed/

nang bcud kyi sems la bltas pas kyang ma rnyed/ bu mo'i rgyud la bltas pas kyang ma rnyed pas/ rang gi rgyud la bltas pas khong na 'dug pa mthong ste/ bu mo la nga'i khong na 'dug ste gsos na nga 'chi byas pas/ bu mo na re/ thabs yod kyi/ ming po khong du gsos la rig pa slob zer/ de ltar byas pas skrag mdzes pa sangs kyi khong du gsos/ khong du gsos pa de la mi 'chi ba'i rig pa yang bslabs der sgrub pa yang byas/ de nas bu mos pha'i gsus pa gshags nas skrag mdzes bton pas pha shi/ shi ba'i ro la skrag mdzes kyis mi 'chi ba'i sngags btab pas pa wa sangs kyang gsos/ de nas skrag mdzes kyis mi 'chi ba'i rig pa shes pas yid dga' ste pha spun mo 'khrid par byas pa bor nas lha'i yul du phyin pas/ bu mo na re/ nga 'khrid par byas nas bor bas khyod kyi sngags la nus pa med par gyur cig byas pas/ des kyang ma spun mo la 'dod pa spyad de rig pa g.yo sgyus bslabs pas na sngags la nus pa ma byung ngo / /de lta bu'i 'chi bdag zhi ba'i sngags ni sbyong rgyud kyi tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas 'byung ba'i oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye ma hā puṇ+ye la sogs pa yin par bshad do/ /des na mi 'chi ba'i gzungs shes pa la yang phan yon de lta bu yod na/ tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob nas gzungs bzlas na lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de ltar 'chi bdag bcom kyang 'phrin las bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro don mdzad dgos pas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ 'gro don mdzad kyang ma rung pa 'dul dgos pas me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ ma rung pa btul kyang dngos por lta ba sun phyung dgos pas ro sreg gi dkyil 'khor gsungs/ de sun phyung yang thugs rje'i chos nyid las ma g.yos pa'i rtags su zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg gsungs/ de ltar ma g.yos kyang 'gro don mdzad dgos pas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gsungs/

'gro ba'i don mdzad kyang 'khor ba dbang du bsdu dgos pa dbang gi sbyin sreg gsungs/ de dbang du bsdus kyang ma rung pa la mngon spyod kyi las dgos pas drag po'i sbyin sreg gsungs/ 'jig rten pa'i gnod pa zhi zhing phun tshogs bsgrub pa'i phyir du 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug gsungs la/ dang po bcu gnyis po de dag la rgyas par phye na/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis te so drug dang / de dag gi steng du las bzhi dang / ro sreg bsnan pas bzhi bcu zhe gcig tu 'gyur ba yin no/ /sbyong rgyud kyi brjod bya'i gtso bo dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug ni/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ shākya thub pa sku'i dkyil 'khor/ tshe dpag med gsung gi dkyil 'khor/ phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor/ 'khor los bsgyur ba yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor/ me ltar 'bar ba 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor dang drug go /'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug ni/ phyag na rdo rje la rgyal chen bzhis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de la phyogs skyong bcus bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de la lha chen brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de la klu chen brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de la 'jigs byed dgus bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de la gza' brgyad rgyu skar dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dang drug yin la/ de dag gi nang nas kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ sbyong rgyud kyi brtag pa dang po nas bstan pa yin zhing / 'di la yang dharma pha la nas lo chen rin chen bzang po/ lo chung / dbus pa dge ser/ gnam kha 'u pa la brgyud pa'i kun rig dang / lo chen nas snyal pa la brgyud pa'i kun rig dang / lo chen nas brag steng pa la brgyud pa'i kun rig dang /

yang dharma pha la nas jo bo rje/ go mi bsgom chen/ skyi nor dzñā na sogs brgyud de rtsa snur 'dzim sogs kyis dar bar byas pa'i kun rig sogs shin tu mang ba zhig yod pa las/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la lugs de gsum char bzhugs kyang / brag steng pa nas bla ma mal lo tsā ba la brgyud pa'i kun rig 'di la thugs rtsis su mdzad pa yin zhing / 'di la lo chen gyi gsung bgros zin bris su btab pa/ snur phyi ru bas mdzad pa'i yo ga'i bshad 'bum chen mo zhes pa yod cing / de ni gzhan phan 'od zer gyi rtsom gzhi lta bu yin par yang bshad la/ des na rje btsun gyi gzhan phan skor gsum gyi nang nas gzhan phan 'od zer ni kun rig sa lugs kyi phyi mo lta bu yin zhing / de la brten khang bsod nams 'bum gyi kun rig spru lung pa kun smon gyi kun rig pur bsod dbang gi kun rig tsha rong pa bsod nams 'od zer gyi kun rig ti shrī grags 'od kyi gzhan phan snying po/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyi kun rig kun rig grag nag ma/ rgyal po dpal gyi kun rig rnams byung ba yin no/ /de ltar sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi nang nas brtag pa dang po nas bstan pa'i kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor sa lugs su grags pa 'di ni yo ga stod lugs kyi brgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bo brag steng pa nas mal lo brgyud sa chen la bka' babs pa yin te/ de yang brag steng pa 'di ni lo chen rin bzang gi thugs sras dam pa lo chen nyid las yo ga'i chos skor mang po zhig dang gzhan yang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gdams pa dpag tu med pa gsan te/ 'od zer can gyi pra brtag pa/ nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/ rkang mgyogs kyi gdams pa/ skye ba brtag pa sogs mang po dang / bye brag tu rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i dbang dang / rjes gnang man ngag mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs par sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams dang bcas pa gnang bas chos skyong 'di'i bka' babs/

zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing / gang dgos thogs med du 'grub pa'i mthu stobs dang nus pa phul du phyin par gyur pa zhig yin la/ 'di dang go rub rin chen bsod nams gnyis gcig yin pa dang / lo chen gyi nye gnas yin par tshar chen gyi chos skor gyi khog phub snyan rgyud rin chen lde mig tu bshad cing / de dag mthun par bdag gi bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis kyang lhag bsam rab dkar gyi dri lan du rin chen bsod nams dang yon tan tshul khrims gnyis mtshan gyi rnam grangs tsam ma gtogs don la gcig pa'i shes byed 'god par mdzad/ yang ngor lugs kyi yo ga sogs kyi zin bris 'ga' zhig tu/ lo chen gyi slob ma brag steng pa go rub rin chen bsod nams/ brag steng pa'i slob ma mal lo tsā ba zhes de gnyis mi gcig pa lta bur bshad mod/ rje btsun rin po ches gzhan phan spyi chings su bkod pa'i sbyong rgyud kyi lo rgyus las/ jo bo chen po'i srol jo bo chen po'i slob ma lo chung legs pa'i shes rab dang / dge bshes brag steng pa go rub yon tan tshul khrims gnyis la gsungs/ brag steng pa'i slob ma mal lo tsā ba/ lo chung gis slob ma dbus pa dge ser/ des kha 'u pa la/ mal dang kha 'u pa la bla ma sa skya pas gsan no/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di nyid ltar na gcig par bshad pa nyid 'dra mo zhig snang ste/ brag steng pa dang / lo chung gi slob ma las sa chen gyis gsan tshul gsungs nas/ gu rub kyi slob ma ma gsungs shing / yon tan tshul khrims zhes pa brag steng pa'i mtshan yang sbyar nas gsungs 'dug pas/ yang na sbyong rgyud kyi lo rgyus gzhan phan spyi chings nas 'byung ba de yi ge ma dag pa yin dgos shing / min na phyis su zin bris rnams su yi ge ma dag pa byung bar snang ste/ rje btsun gyi gsung de las dge bshes brag steng pa gu rub yon tan tshul khrims zhes sbyar nas bris pa de phyis su dge bshes brag steng pa zhes yar bcad/

gu rub yon tan tshul khrims zhes mar bcad pas yi ge ma dag gam snyam ste dpyad par bya'o/ /gang ltar de lta bu'i brag steng pa des mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa la yo ga stod lugs kyi dbang la sogs pa yo ga'i skor rnams dang / chos skyong gi chos skor la sogs pa gsan te/ mal lo 'di spyir rdo rje theg pa mtha' dag la mkhas/ de'i nang nas bal po pham thing pa sku mched dang / klog skya shes rab brtsegs la 'khor lo bde mchog gi skor yongs su rdzogs par gsan/ khyad par bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud tshar bdun cu rtsa gsum gsan te thams cad la tshogs 'khor re mdzad/ yi ge bdun pa'i las tshogs thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub pa sogs grub pa'i yon tan dpag tu med do/ /de'i drung du bla ma sa skya pa chen pos spyir chos mang po dang / khyad par sbyong rgyud kyi brtag pa dang po'i dngos bstan gyi gtso bo kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang / rgyu de nyid kyi bshad bka' sogs yo ga'i chos skor mang du gsan nas dar bar mdzad pas kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang zhes deng sang gi bar du phyag len dang bka' pa gnyis ka dpyad pas rnam par dag cing dar rgyas su bzhugs pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i bla ma chen po de nyid rigs khyad par can thog mar 'od gsal lha las babs pa gnam lha'i rigs/ bar du g.ya' spangs skyes cig bya bas srin po skya rengs khrag med bsad/ srin lcam si li ma 'phrogs te khab tu bzhes pa las sras 'khon par skyes 'khrungs pa nas brtsams srin po dang 'khon pa'i rigs yin pas 'khon gyi gdung brgyud/ mthar 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang btab pa nas bzung ste sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dam rigs gsum mgon po'i gdung brgyud du bsam bzhin du skye ba bzhes nas mkhas pa dang grub pa chen po'i go 'phang thob nas lta ci/ yum gyi mngal nas btsas ma thag pa'i tshe yang lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi spyi bor zhabs kyi pad+mo 'jog par rang gzhan thams cad mthun snang du grub pa'i skyes bu chen po'i rigs su 'khrungs nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa yin te/

de yang rgyu mtshan ni/ spyir rigs dman par gang zag bzang po 'byung ba yang srid mod/ de la rgyal rigs dang / rje rigs dang / bram ze'i rigs dang / khyim bdag gi rigs mtho ba dag gi rigs kyi dregs pas bskur ba shas chung bas bstan pa la phan mi che/ dper na skal bzang gi sangs rgyas rnams 'dzam bu'i gling nas rgyal rigs la gtso bor byed pa'i tshe rgyal rigs dang / bram ze'i rigs la gtso bor byed pa'i tshe de'i rigs su 'byung ba bzhin no/ /rigs khyad par can de lta bur byang chub sems dpa' phyag na pad+mo'am spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa dpal nyid 'gro ba'i don la bsam bzhin du byon pa bla chen 'di yin te/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dang / bla ma gnam kha'ub pa gnyis kyi ma cig zhang mo bya ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pa zhig rgyun du 'khor ba gzigs pas 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos rigs sras bskrun pa'i cho ga mdzad pa na bla chen 'di nyid chu pho spre'u'i lo sku bltams shing / sku sha dkar la 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhi zhing dul ba/ 'gro ba kun la ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes lta bu'i thugs rje chen po zhig byung bas brtse ba chen por grags pa dang / zhing gzhan du gshegs pa na/ bde ba can/ po ta la/ ser mdog can/ nub phyogs u rgyan dang bzhir gshegs par bshad pa'i dang po gnyis spyan ras gzigs kyi longs sprul gyi zhing khams yin pas rang gnas su byon pas kyang gong gi don de nyid grub bo/ /yang bla chen 'di nyid rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal ldan bir+wa pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa yin par bshad pa la yang 'gal ba med de/ siṅga la'i gling na bzhugs pa'i mkhan po dgra bcom pa zhig gis a tsar+ya zhig la bod na rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sprul pa sa skya pa bya ba yod pas der song zhig ces lung bstan pa ltar byon nas sa chen la gdams pa mnos pa'i mchog thob pa'i slob ma gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur pa dang /

khams pa sga lo la rgya gar du rtsa rlung gi gegs byung ba rgya gar gyi paṇa grub sus kyang sel bar ma nus pa'i tshe/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gros bod na rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sprul pa sa skya pa bya ba yod kyis de can song zhig ces gsungs pa ltar byon pas bla chen gung thang na bzhugs pa na mjal/ gegs sel gyi dmigs pa phra mo zhig bstan pas de ma thag grol te/ rgya bod gnyis na khyod las gdams pa che ba yod ri gsungs nas dbu snyung thengs gsum bzhes pa sogs byung bas so/ /de ltar na yang tha snyad du mi g.yo ba dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mngon sum du zhal bstan nas gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa gnang bas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag la thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab mnga' ba yin te/ de yang sa chen 'di nyid dgung lo bcu gcig bzhes pa'i tshe yab sku gshegs pa na/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags kyis bka' drin chen pos bskyangs te/ gzims khang rnying mar 'jam dbyangs bsgrubs pas phyi'i bar chad bsal te sgrol mas zhal gzigs nang gi bar chad bsal/ mi g.yo ba'i zhal gzigs te zla ba drug na 'phags pa 'jam dbyangs kyi zhal gzigs/ zhen pa bzhi bral la sogs pa phar phyin gyi gdams pa zab mo'i bka' drin stsal ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i ba ri lo tsā ba ni 'khrungs yul khams kyi g.yer ma thang kha/ gdung rigs ba ri mdo smad tshangs pa bzhi'i nang nas gling ya'i rigs su 'khrungs pa/ byis pa'i dus nyid nas yi ge drug pa kho na bzla zhing spyan ras gzigs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa zhig yin pa las/ mkha' 'gros lung bstan te dgung lo bcu dgu pa la dbus gtsang du byon/ lam bar du sgrol ma gtso 'khor gsum pa zhal gzigs shing chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa las bskyabs/ de nas dbu ru stod du phebs nas mkhan po ku sa li sa zhang ston rin chen dang / slob dpon bstan cig pa tshul khrims grags las rab tu byung /

mtshan rin chen grags su btags/ de dus kyi mkhas grub phal cher la gtugs nas thos bsam rgya chen po mdzad/ de nas lha sar byon nas jo bo la bskor ba 'bum 'ther mdzad pas/ mnal lam du jo bo'i g.yas na spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gcig bzhugs 'dug pa'i zhal nas/ khyod yo byad mang po khyer nas rgya gar du song / don mang po 'grub cing sems can la phan par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pa la brten nas 'phags yul du byon nas/ bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta ye rang pa chen po la bde mchog yab yum sogs chos mang du gsan/ sgra bslabs pas mkhas par mkhyen/ de nas rgya gar du 'byor te thog mar bla ma mahā yo gi dang mjal/ rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs dang gdams pa zhus te nub cig tshogs 'khor mdzad dus/ bla ma'i gsung gis nam mkhar rdo rje phag mo bzhugs pa mthong ngam gsungs pa na/ nam mkhar bltas pas phag mo gtso 'khor lnga mngon sum du gzigs te ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma thugs rgyud la 'khrungs/ de dus rgya gar na grags che ba'i bla ma rdo rje gdan pa chung ba dang mjal/ dbang dang gdams pa bshad bka' sogs mang du gsan/ gzhan yang rdo rje gdan pa chen po la sogs pa la yi dam gyi lha'i sgrub thabs stong rtsa gcig gsan/ de rnams kyi nang nas zab cing mkho ba brgya rtsa brgyad phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas lo paṇa gnyis kyis bsgyur/ bla mas de dag gi spyi'i mngon rtogs shig so so'i sgrub thabs gsal ba re/ de rnams re re la'ang bshad lung / byin gyis rlabs pa'i lung / rjes su bzlas pa'i lung / dam bcas pa'i lung ste ste bzhi bzhi'i rjes gnang gi bka' dang lag len rnams spyan drangs nas dar bar mdzad pa deng sang yang sgrub thabs kun las btus pa brgya rtsa zhes yongs su grags shing dar rgyas su bzhugs pa 'di yin no/ /gzhan yang bla ma rdo rje gdan pa la mu stegs kyi gnod pa bzlog pa'i man ngag kha 'bar ma'i gtor chen/

bha ya na'i man ngag drag po'i sbyin sreg rnams kyang gsan/ bod du 'byon khar bas mtha' zhig tu skyo sangs la byon pa na/ der yi dwags mang po ngu bzhin 'dug pa la/ khyed rnams ci la ngu gsungs pas/ khyed 'di kar bzhugs na nged rnams la gtor ma mang po byin pas bkres pa'i nad mi 'byung ba la/ khyed bod la 'byon pas da gtor ma byin mkhan med pas bkres skom gyis sdug bsngal bar 'gyur zer bas/ de'i ched du 'bras mi khur nyi shu 'jal/ gser srang dgu dang bcas pa bzhag nas yi dwags kyi gtor ma'i rgyun chen po btsugs/ de nas bal por byon te/ der bod kyi mgron po rnams gang du babs pa'i gnas po'i zong gi phyed re gnas glar khyer ba dang / 'phral byed spyod phran bu ma legs na'ang rgyal po'i chad pa 'ongs shing / na tsha byung na nang nas phyir phud pa sogs tshong pa rnams la ngal ba mang po 'byung ba zhig yod pas/ de dag gi ched du thang chen po zhig rin gyis bcal nas/ der tshong pa sdod pa'i khang pa che chung mang po bzos/ bod thang zhes ming btags/ der sngar gyi nyes pa rnams mi 'byung zhing / mgron po rnams rang zong gi rang nor mkho dgu bsgrub chog pa mdzad/ gzhan yang tshad pa skyobs pa'i phyir du bco sa ri zhes pa sa rdo brtsigs pa med pa'i shing khang chen po zhig bzos te zhig bzos kyi rten du nor mang po bzhag de ltar lho bal du lo dgu bzhugs/ bzhi bcu zhe gsum la bod du byon nas/ thog mar lung steng pa dge bshes dkon mchog skyabs bya bas sna len dang yun ring zhabs tog byas te/ der gdul bya mang po la dbang rgyud sgrub thabs sogs kyi chos kyi 'khor lo mang du bskor/ de nas 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos sa skyar gdan drangs te zhabs tog yun ring mdzad chos mang du gsan/ de nas dgung lo drug cu re gsum pa la mkhon dkon mchog rgyal po sku gshegs te sras sa skya pa chen po sku na phra bas bla ma 'dis gdan sa lo brgyad mdzad/

de'i ring la chos kyang mang po gsungs/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po'i phyi rten du rnam rgyal mchod rten bzhengs te/ rnam rgyal gyi gzungs 'bum gter gsum dang khri tsho bdun bzhugs pa'i rnam rgyal gyi tsha tsha dang / rgya bod kyi rten byin rlabs can du ma nang du bzhugs shing / gzhan yang bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel du ma mdzad/ rab gnas kyi don du yang rnam rgyal gyi cho ga stong phrag gnyis mdzad nas tshes brgyad kyi nyin me tog 'thor bar mdzad pa'i tshe/ mchod rten bum gter las 'od zer ser po gser btso ma'i kha dog lta bu 'phros te sa dang bar snang thams cad yongs su khyab pa dang dril bu'i sgra 'u ru ru khrol ba dang / legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra mi che tsam lan bzhi grag pa kun gyis thos byung bas ya mtshan du gyur/ de nas bzung ste phyogs thams cad du bkra shis pa'i ltas du ma byung zhing dpal ldan sa skya'i ngo mtshar ba'i rten bzhi'i nang tshan byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar bar bzhugs pa 'di yin no/ /gzhan yang rje btsun ma sgrol ma dngos su bzhugs pa'i g.yu khar mo'i gtsug lag khang dang / mchod rten dang / zam pa/ mgron khang mang po brtsigs pa sogs kyi sgo nas kyang 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad do/ /de nas dgung lo bdun cu don gcig pa la dpal ldan sa skya'i gdan sa bla chen nyid la gtad de/ bar phug rong gi dben gnas su thugs dam kho na la bzhugs te/ bdun cu don gsum pa dbyug pa zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la bla ma sa skya pa chen po la/ nga ni bde ba nas bde bar 'gro/ yi dam 'jam dbyangs/ rnam 'joms/ mi g.yo ba/ spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma/ rnam rgyal rnams nyin re bzhin ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin zhal mthong / khyad par thugs rje chen po sa skya/ las stod byang rgyas/ g.yas ru kha stod rnams su nyin zhag bdun re tsam 'bral med du zhal mthong bas lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung ba yin/

bde ba yin/ yid 'gyod pa sel ba yin/ khyed jo sras kyi bu theg pa chen po pa yin pas bstan 'gro'i don kho na ma yin pa/ rang don gyi 'khri ba spongs/ ci byas chos su 'gro ba mdzod gsungs pa'i zhal ta mdzad de/ lus gnad kyi ngang nas bde bar gshegs so/ /de lta bu'i lo tsā ba de la sa chen 'dis sgrub thabs brgya rtsa la sogs pa mang du gsan/ brang ti dar ma snying po la mngon pa/ khyung rin chen grags dang me lhang tsher la dbu tshad/ gnam kha'u pa dar ma rgyal mtshan sku mched la gsang 'dus dang / mgon po zhal gyi skor/ sgyi chu ba dgra lha 'bar la kyai rdor/ gung thang pa mal lo tsā ba la bde mchog dang / yo ga gshin rje gshed/ mgon po'i skor gyi man ngag rnams gsan/ pu hrang lo chung la yang bde mchog gsan te/ sgyi chu ba la kye rdor gsan pa'i nub mo mnal lam du srid pa'i rgya mtsho yin zer ba'i mtsho dmar mer re ba gcig la zam pa gsum btsugs te/ nye ba la mi gsum/ bar pa la bdun/ ring ba la mang po zhig bsgral bar rmis pa dang / dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu pa la bse mgon nag po 'phur shes sa skyar spyan drangs/ de'i tshe zhang ston la gsung ngag rin po che lam zab mo'i bka' drin lo ngo bzhi la nyams khrid du gsan te/ bsgrub pa lung sbyin gyi skabs su zhang ston gyis mdun gyi nam mkhar sku bdun sprul te ngas sgrub pa tsam byed rgyu ma byung ste/ khyed yid ches pa'i phyir 'di tsam yin/ spyir khyed kyis sgrub pa gtso bor byas na tshe 'di la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob/ bshad pa gtso bor byas na mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i slob ma gsum/ bzod pa thob pa bdun/ rtogs pa dang ldan pa brgyad cu tsam 'byung zhing lo bco brgyad kyi bar du chos 'di 'chad pa lta ci/ ming tsam yang gzhan la ma bzlo gsungs so/ /yang lan cig mal gyi nye gnas mdzad pa na snyung gzhi thu mo zhig byung ba'i tshe/

bzo mo tsi tsi zhes pa bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal des sman phul bas dwangs na'ang / re zhig na de'i snyung ro langs te yun ring po zhig snyung bas gsung ngag rin po che'i tshig don thams cad brjed pa 'di shes pa bod na ni med pas 'dri sa yang med/ rgya gar du phyin kyang ci 'dra yod mi shes snyam thugs ma bde bar sa skya'i brang khang rnying par mtshams bcad de bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pas thog mar zhang dgon pa bas rmi lam du byon te gsung ngag yongs su rdzogs pa gsungs/ slar mngon sum du byon nas gsungs pas thams cad gsos par gyur te/ de dus bstod pa mdzad pa'i nang na/ rang gi spyad pa'i las las gyur pa'i g.yo ba yi/ /nad kyis btab pa khyed kyi thugs rje'i zil mnan nas/ /rmongs par gyur pa ye shes chen po'i ros gang ba/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyed kyi mthu yis rjes su skyongs/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /de nas rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan bir+wa pa gtso 'khor lnga dam chos sgo skyel gyi tshul du byon te/ spyir rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi man ngag khyad par lcags ri khong mi 'da' ba'i zab chos bzhi la sogs te mdor na gsung ngag nye brgyud kyi gdams pa'i gnad zab mo'i bdud rtsi ngom par gsol te/ de dus bstod pa mdzad pa na/ a la la te lhan skyes spros bral las/ /'di 'dra'i rab brjid dpal 'bar bsam las 'das/ /gang de rje btsun bir+wa pa zhes pa/ /bdag gi dpal du gyur pa e ma ho/ /zhes sogs 'byung ba yin no/ /de nas dgung lo lnga bcu pa la zhang ston gyi gdams pa'i bka' rgya grol te/ mdo khams kyi mkhas pa a seng gis zhus pa'i ngor gsung ngag thog mar bka' stsal/ gzhung bshad a seng mar grags pa yi ger bkod/ rgyud man ngag zab mo'i bdud rtsi mang du spel/ sku'i bkod pa mi 'dra ba drug bstan/ mthar dgung lo re bdun pa sa pho stag gi dbyug pa zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la sku 'bum rnam rgyal du grags par chos dbyings su gshegs te/

bde ba can/ po ta la/ u rgyan/ byang phyogs gser mdog can dang bzhi na sku'i bkod pa bzhis skal ldan gyi gdul bya du ma'i don mdzad cing da lta yang bzhugs par bshad do/ /don 'di la phag mo grub pa'i rnam thar las/ bde ba can/ byang a yu ta ra/ gser mdog can dang gsum na sku'i bkod pa gsum bstan te bzhugs pa 'di rang ngo mtshar che zhes gsungs so/ /slob ma'i mchog ni/ zhang ston gyi lung bstan dang / sgyi chu bar kye rdor gyi dbang gsan pa'i nub mo'i mnal lam dang mthun par/ siṅga gling gi rnal 'byor pa/ byang chub sems dpa' stag bsgom pa skyid 'bar ba ste mchog gi dngos grub thob pa gsum/ rje btsun chen po/ zhu byas dngos grub/ dga' ston rdo rje grags/ bsgom pa 'od zer grags/ nags bsgom bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ tshar kha'i rnal 'byor pa/ mang chung ma ste bzod pa thob pa bdun/ gzhan yang rtogs pa dang ldan pa brgyad cu dang / khams pa a seng / lho pa zhu byas/ klokya jo sras chos grags/ thugs sras gnyan phul byung ba gtsug tor rgyal po'am/ mtshan dngos bsod nams rdo rje/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ zangs ri phug pa/ khams pa sga thang / gnyag bzhi dar ma dbang phyug rgyal mtshan te pho brgyad/ rang sras kun dga' 'bar gyi yum jo lcam phur mo/ g.ya' lung gi jo mo 'a 'u ma/ mang mkhar gyi jo mo mang chung ma ste mo gsum dang bcu gcig la gzhung bshad gces par 'dzin mdzad thugs sras bcu gcig ces bya ste/ zhu byas kyis sdebs pa'i bstod pa las/ zab don yongs su rdzogs pa'i slob ma ni/ /pho brgyad mo gsum dag la yi ger gdams/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang / sna ro ban+dhe gshin rje grags/ stod bsgom byang chub shes rab/ mi nyag pradzñā dz+wa la/ zhu brag dmar ba/ zhang ze dmar pa/ 'u yug gi g.yar sbu ba/ phag mo grub pa ste gzhung bshad mdzad pa'i slob bu'am/ tshig rkang rnam par 'grel ba'i thugs sras bdun/

la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar/ khams pa sga lo/ ne tse sbal ston/ gshin rdo rje bzang po ste phyogs kyi mkhas grub chen po bzhi la sogs pa bgrang ba'i yul las 'das pa zhig byon pa yin no/ /de thams cad kyi gtsug rgyan dam pa bla chen nyid dang mi gnyis pa'i yon tan mnga' ba ni/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo ste/ 'di ni 'khrungs ma thag saṃ skṛ ta'i skad smra zhing rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas te/ nga ni byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das pa'o zhes lan gnyis kyi bar du gsungs/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa mkhan po bsod nams rtse mo rdo rje theg pa mtha' dag gi dbang phyug dam pa sa skyar skyes so zhes pa'i yi ge rdo rje gdan gyi sgo'i ya them la btab pa ko'u shaṃ bhi'i paṇ+ḍi ta de wa ma tis phyogs thams cad du bsgrags pas mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul par yang gdon mi za'o/ /de ltar na yang tha snyad du slob dpon mi thub zla ba'am/ sbyangs dka' zla ba'am/ skar rgyal zla ba zhes mtshan gyi khyad par gsum dang ldan pa de nyid sogs paṇ+ḍi ta bcu gcig tu bar ma chad par skye ba bzhes pas/ shes bya rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhyen pa thogs med du rgyas pa dang / dgung lo gsum pa la 'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma/ kye rdor/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams zhal gzigs shing / ma bde ba'i dogs pa ci byung yang rnal 'byor dbang phyug la zhus chog pa byung / dgung lo bcu drug yan la spyir yab chos mtha' dag dang / khyad par yo ga rnal 'byor rgyud kyi chos skor rnams yongs su rdzogs par bla chen nyid las gsan te mkhas par sbyangs pa sogs rgyud dang man ngag mtha' dag gi sgro 'dogs chod/ bcu bdun pa la cha pa'i drung du byon/ snga phyir lo bcu gcig tu mdo phyogs kyi sgro 'dogs bcad/ der bdun pa la chos la 'jug pa'i sgo brtsams/

nyer brgyad pa la gsung ngag gnang ste/ de'i lta ba'i skabs su nam mkha' 'od kyi gur khang gi dbus su rje btsun chen po 'jam dpal/ zhu byas la kye rdor/ gnyag rmog ston/ gtsug tor dbon po sogs bco lnga la spyan ras gzigs su bstan te/ de dus kyi chos nyan bcu dgu dag pa'i snang ba la bkod cing / rje btsun chen po la sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ u rgyan sogs yul nyer bzhi dang / po ta la sogs du mar dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral du byon te brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad pa'i tshe gnas sam sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa'i rtogs pa bskrun par mdzad pa sogs ngo mtshar mtha' yas so/ /de nas zhe gcig pa chu pho stag gi smal zla'i tshes bcu gcig la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ /rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs gdung dbyangs ma'i mchan las/ tshes bcu'i dgong / rje btsun sku mched sogs kyis tshes bcu'i mchod pa mdzad/ nangs par rje pas byon pas/ na bza' sbu gu thib se sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod la bzhud/ gdung dbyangs kyis gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ na bza'i sbu gu nas bung ba'i skad lta bu'i lung bstan khyad par can byung zhes bshad do/ /yang sa chen gyi thugs sras bzod thob bdun gyi nang nas rje btsun rin po che ni/ don la mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang gnyis su med pa zhig ste/ jo bo rje bod du byon nas dbus gtsang du 'byon pa'i lam 'brong ngu lar mdzad de/ dpon po ri'i ngos la 'brong gnyis rtswa bza' ba gzigs nas/ ma 'ongs pa na gnas pha gir ma hā kā la gnyis 'gro don mdzad pa'i ltas su 'dug gsungs te sa skya pa'i chos skyong gur zhal rnam gnyis la mdzad pa 'di lung bstan nas/ slar gdan sa chen po dang nye ba'i phyag 'tshal sgang bya bar phebs pa ni chibs las bshol te sa dkar logs la phyag mchod rgyas pa zhig mdzad/ sa dkar po pha gi'i ngos la hrīḥyig gcig

dhiḥyig bdun/ hūm̐ yig gcig rnams 'dug pas/ ma 'ongs pa na spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa zhig 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa bdun/ phyag rdor gyi sprul pa gcig rnams pha gir byon nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i ltas yin zhes 'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud 'byung bar lung bstan pa dang / rje btsun sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo gcig tu bsdus pa mgon po 'jam dbyangs su gzigs pa yin te/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi 'phrin zhu las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /gcig tu bsdus pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dge bsnyen mchog gi skur bstan nas/ /bdag gi 'khrul pa'i dra ba bcad/ /yun ring dus nas 'di nyid ni/ /khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes so zhes/ /mkha' la de lta'i sgra grags pas/ /legs 'doms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar na 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang rnam dbyer ma mchis mod/ 'on kyang tha snyad du sgo mtha' yas pa'i blo gros la sogs pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skye ba bdun bar ma chad par bzhes par bshad pas rig pa'i gnas ma lus pa la mkhyen pa nyi ma ltar gsal ba dang / dgung lo brgyad pa la byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan las tshangs spyod dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mnos te/ snga phyir bla chen yab sras sogs las mdo sngags kyi chos tshul rgya cher gsan zhing / khyad par rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi dbang dang bshad pa cho ga'i lag len rgyud dang rgya gzhung gi don 'grel rnams kyi lung dang bshad pa sogs mtha' chod par gsan/ bcu gsum pa las skya'i gdan sa mdzad/ de dag gi skabs su kye rdor rgyud gsum gyi po ti gsol ba'i snang ba byung bas chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid thugs su chud cing / dgung lo nyi shu pa'i tshe nyin par g.yengs bar mnal du song ba'i mnal lam du mtshan brjod phyed tsam bton pa'i snang ba byung ba dang / yang lan gcig tshar gcig bton pa'i snang ba mnal lam du byung bas mnal sad pa na thugs la 'dzin ma dgos par byung ba dang /

de'i tshe 'phags pa 'jam dpal skye ba bdun gyi bar gyi yi dam gyi lha'o zhes pa'i sgra nam mkha' las byung / de nas dgung lo nga drug pa'i tshe snye mo ru mtshams kyi gtsang kha dgon par mtshan gyi 'od gsal chen po'i ngang las/ bla ma sa skya pa chen pos sku ye shes kyi snang ba sprul te/ rdo dkar la 'jam pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi rnam par yod pa dbus su hūm̐ dang a mtshams bzhi ya ra la wa bzhi yod pa/ phyogs bzhi stong par yod pa zhig bstan nas/ ngas khyod la chos bstan pa thams cad kyi don 'dir 'dus pa yin te/ dang po chos nyid gdan du bya/ /gnyis pa rlung la sbar zin bya/ /gtum mo'i me drod rab tu sbar/ /byang sems chu rgyun dbu mar gzhug /sa sogs 'byung ba dbang du bsdu/ /ye shes lnga ni mngon gyur nas/ /'chi ba med pa'i gnas thob bo/ /zhes gsungs te/ lam 'bras shin tu nye brgyud ces grags pa brda don gsal ba'i bka' drin mchog tu mnos pas phyi nang gi rten 'brel thams cad thugs su tshud/ 'di la dus 'khor ba'i bla ma rnams sbyor drug gi snying po tshigs bcad du bsdus nas bla ma chen po'i 'od gsal gyi ngang du bstan par bzhed/ yang lan gcig dbus su bla ma sa skya pa chen po la nye ba'i sras brgyad kyis bskor/ g.yas su shākya thub pa la nyan thos brgyad kyis bskor/ g.yon du kyai rdo rje la lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba'i zhal mngon sum du bstan nas/ khyed sdom pa len na su la len/ dbang bskur zhu na su la zhu gsungs pa na/ bdag sdom pa len pa'i slob dpon nam/ dbang bskur zhu ba'i bla ma ni chos kyi rje nyid do zhes zhus pas/ de kho na bzhin te khyod kyis legs par rtogs pa de bzhin no zhes dbugs dbyung ste/ chos dang 'jig rten gyi dge legs thams cad yar ldan du gyur to/ /yang kha che paṇa chen dang mjal dus khong rnams kyi rjes su 'gab 'dre gdug pa can zhig 'dug pa la bgegs bskrod mdzad pas dpon slob rnams kyi phyir 'brangs ma nus par khams kyi phyogs su song ba dang /

der skabs rdor dril bar snang la rang 'gar khro lo 'jog par mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang kha che paṇa chen gyis shangs sreg shing du zla ba gza' 'dzin gyi sgo yig btab pa na/ rje btsun 'dis ro rkyang gnyis su rlung sems 'gro 'ongs bkag ste/ dbu ma'i nang du khams dkar dmar bsres pas de'i mtshan mo gza' 'dzin ma byung / de'i sang nyin chos rje sa paṇa gyis paṇa chen la de ci yin zhus pas/ nga brdzun mar btang ba'i phyir khyed kyi khu bo dge bsnyen rgan po de nga rgyal gyin yod de la dka' las ci yang zhig byung song zhes gsungs par grag go /de nas re zhig na chu lung rdo rje'i phug tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bde ba can du spyan 'dren gyi pho nya lan gsum byung la dang po phyir slog gnyis pa'i tshe lha rnams kyis bde ba can gyi bsngags pa dang mi mjed kyi mi bsngags pa mang du brjod de spyan 'dren pa na/ kho bo zhing bzang ba la dga' ba dang / ngan pa la mi dga' ba med cing / zhing sbyong ba la dman pa nyid khyad par che/ kho bo la ltos pa'i mgon med pa mang po yod gsungs nas slog de nas dgung lo bdun cu pa'i tshe/ ci nas kyang gshegs dgos zhes nan gyis spyan drangs/ bde ba can gyi bkod pa yang gzigs/ de dus tho rangs chos rje pas tsog pur 'dug ste gsol ba btab pas cung zad mnal ba na/ bde ba can nas 'ongs zer ba'i lha tshogs nam mkha'i khams khyab pa rnams kyis seng ge'i khri rgyan du mas brgyan pa dang / mchod pa bsam mi khyab pa dang bcas pa thogs nas rje btsun bde ba can du spyan 'dren zer ba la gsol ba btab pas cang mi smra bar 'khod/ rje btsun nyid la gsol ba btab pas gshegs pa la spro bar 'dug ste/ zhal nas khyod kyang bde ba can gyi bkod pa la ltos gsungs phyag gis brda sprod mdzad byung bas/ baiḍūr+ya'i sa gzhi rin po che'i ljon pa sogs bkod pa yid 'phrog pa gzigs/ der chos rjes dang po gser mdog can du gshegs gsungs pa dang mi 'gal lam zhus pas/

bla ma yab sras kyi drung du skye bar gyur cig ces pa'i smon lam gyi mthu las re zhig bde ba can du 'gro/ /der yun mi ring ba zhig bsdad nas gser mdog can du sngar bshad pa'i tshul gyis 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha byad du byas nas sa lam phal cher bgrod skye ba gsum pa'i lus rten de la 'tshang rgya rgyu med pa'i tshul gyis rgya bar re ba yin gsungs pa sogs chos rje pa la mnal lam ngo mtshar can de ltar bstan te/ me pho byi ba'i dbo'i zla ba'i tshes bcu gnyis la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs shing / de nas yun mi ring ba zhig nas gser mdog can gyi zhing khams su 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha byad kyis 'bras bu mngon du byas par nges te/ slob dpon rin po che mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i tshe na bza'i sbu gu nas sbrang po che lta bu'i skad cig bar snang la 'thon te/ khyod 'di nas byang phyogs su zhing khams dpag tu med pa 'das pa na sangs rgyas kyi zhing gser mdog can bya bar de bzhin gshegs pa gser 'od rnam par rtsen pa'i rgyal po'i bstan pa la 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po bsod nams mtha' yas bya ba bzhugs/ de'i sras 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po yon tan mtha' yas su skye'o/ /zhes pa'i sgra rang grags su byung bar bshad pas so/ /de ltar me mo yos la sku bltams pa nas bzung me pho byi ba la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs kyi bar du bstan pa'i bya ba kho na mdzad cing / khyad par yo ga la dkyil chog rdo rje 'byung ba'i ṭik+ka/ sbyong rgyud kyi bsdus don/ 'bru gnyer bar byed pa mchan bshad/ 'chad thabs kyi man ngag ston pa gzhan phan spyi 'ching / cho ga'i rnam gzhag ston pa gzhan phan 'od zer/ lag len gyi rnam gzhag ston pa gzhan phan nyer mkho rnams mdzad de/ yo ga'i bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de'i thugs sras kyi dam pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan du gyur pa ni/

chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta nyid yin la/ gzhan la yang dkar shākya grags/ nub pa rig 'dzin grags/ sna ro ban+dhe gshin rje grags/ gsal la ba dbang phyug grags te grags pa'i mtha' can bzhi/ de bzhi'i steng du gras ston blo gros grags/ dga' ston rdo rje grags/ lde ston dkon mchog grags/ sa ston 'jigs med grags te grags pa mi brgyad dang / mu tshu byang chub grags/ gtsang ston brtson 'grus grags/ lha thog yon tan zung / rigs ldan shes rab rin chen te gur rgyan zhu ba po'i slob bu bzhi/ jo sras lcags kyi rdo rje/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chen po/ rtsis 'dul gzhon nu seng ge khams kyi 'dzi ston dge slong ste rig 'dzin sdom brtson chen po bzhi la sogs pa mang du byung ba yin no/ /de rnams kyi nang nas bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta ni/ kha che paṇa chen siṅga lar bzhugs pa'i tshe hor gyi pho lha gnam the dkar pos hor yul du gdan 'dren par byung ba na/ rang gi yi dam gyi lha rje btsun ma sgrol ma la zhus pas/ khyed kyis phyin kyang phan mi thogs/ bod na khyod kyi slob ma 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan bya ba yod des phan thogs pas lung ston cig gsungs pa ltar lung bstan pa dang / rje btsun rin po che byang gi nyi lung phug par bzhugs dus nye ba'i rim gro bas mthong snang la hor gyi cha lugs can gyi rta pa sa gzhi go skabs pa tsam byung / rje btsun gyi phug par song / mig 'khrul ba yin nam snyam pa ltar phyin pas thams cad rje btsun gyi drung na gral byas 'dug de'i khrod na khye'u dkar po dung so khor mar yod pa zhig langs te/ rje btsun la phyag 'tshal te 'di rnams hor gyi lha gnam the dkar po bya ba khyed spyan 'dren du 'ongs par 'dug nga gnyan chen thang lha bya ba yin khong rnams kyi lam sna dang lo tsā la yong ba yin/ hor gyi lha mi thams cad la phan pa'i phyir 'byon dgos zhu ba la/

rje btsun chen pos nga na so yang rgas/ hor dang las 'brel cher med pas phan mi thogs/ nga'i tsha bo 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan spyan drangs na hor dang las 'brel yang che bar 'dug pas phan thogs pa 'ongs zhes lung bstan pa dang / gtsang nags phug pa 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'od zer gyis mnal lam zin nas shar phyogs su 'phur byon nas/ ri bo rtse lnga yin zer ba'i spang ri bzang po zhig gi rtser gnas gzhi bzang po lta bu zhig gi dbus su khang pa bzang po zhig 'dug pa la/ 'di 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi pho brang yin snyam bskor ba 'ga' byas/ sgo yun ring du ma rnyed pa la slar shar phyogs nas sgo zhig byung / nang du byon pas gtsug lag khang bzang po zhig gi nang na bla ma chos rje pa bzhugs 'dug 'di 'jam pa'i dbyangs yin snyam phyag 'tshal byin rlabs zhus pas/ gsung ni gang yang ma byung / glegs bam dar sna tshogs kyis dril ba zhig gnang / kha phye nas bltas pas mtshan brjod kyi dpe gser gyis bris pa zhig 'dug de ma thag mnal sad de/ de phyin chad chos rje pa tha mal pa yin snyam pa skad cig kyang ma skyes pa dang / chos rje 'di ling chu rtser khab na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ mi mang pos ri bo rtse lnga la mchod pa 'bul du phyin pas/ thams cad rmi lam mthun par 'jam pa'i dbyangs 'di na mi bzhugs ling chu rtser khab na bzhugs zer ba byung bas/ slar log ste ling chu rtser phyin pas/ chos rje 'di mi mang po la chos gsungs pa dang mjal/ chos kyang thob ste thams cad la 'jam pa'i dbyangs yin snyam pa'i nges shes skyes pa dang / lha rje bi rdzi sogs mos gus can gyi slob ma mang pos 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos su mthong ba sogs kyis mgon po 'jam dbyangs dang rnam dbyer med pa la som nyi cung zad kyang mi dgos mod/ gdul bya'i snang ngor yang dbyig gnyen dang rngog blo ldan shes rab/ gcen kun dga' 'bar sogs paṇ+ḍi ta'i skye ba bar ma chad par nyi shu/

rtsa bdun du rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs pas shes bya thams cad la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob nas/ slar yang dge slong gzhon nu'i zol gyis bstan 'gro'i don mdzad par bsam bzhin du byon pa yin te/ de yang bdag nyid chen po 'di ni slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i chu pho stag gi lo de la ngo mtshar gyi ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas bltams/ btsas ma thag tu saṃ skṛ ta'i gsung snyan par sgrog pa dang / lañtsa sogs rgya gar gyi yig rigs mang po 'bri ba sogs mdzad/ bco lnga pa yan chad la rje btsun chen po'i drung du gong ma'i gsung gi bcud mdo sngags kyi zab gnad yongs su rdzogs/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa la mtshan gyi 'od gsal chen po'i ngang la a phyi 'bum pa'i drung du slob dpon dbyig gnyen la mngon pa mdzod zla ba gcig gi bar du sad pa'i snang ba byung ba gsan pa na tshig don thams cad thugs su tshud de/ phyis su kha che paṇa chen la gsan pas khyad par ma byung gsungs so/ /yang tshogs pa zhig la rnam 'grel gyi mchod brjod saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du gsungs pa'i tshe phrag gong gnyis nas nyi zla shar te 'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab pa zhig rmis pa dang / dus gzhan zhig na phyogs kyi glang po'i gdan sar bskos pas gshegs par zhu zer nas byon pas brag phug bzang po ngos la glegs bam gyi brtsigs pa mthon po dang bcas pa zhig gi lde mig gtad pa rmis/ yang kha che paṇa chen bod la ma 'byon gong tsam gyi mnal lam du chos zab mo rdo rje'i glur len pa gsan zhing / de nas dgung lo nyi shu tsam nas zhu ston rdo rje skyabs/ mtshur ston gzhon seng / brtsegs pa dbang phyug seng ge spyi bo lhas pa byang chub 'od la sogs pa rnams la ci rigs par lung gi chos mang po dang / zhi byed rdzogs chen spyod la sogs pa gsang sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i gdams pa mang po gsan nas khong du chud par mdzad/

nyer gsum pa la kha che paṇa chen dang mjal te/ de nyid 'khor dang bcas pa la tshad ma la sogs pa'i rig gnas che ba lnga dang / snyan ngag la sogs pa'i rig gnas chung ba lnga ste bcus bsdus pa'i zab bcud thams cad chos sgo skyel gyi tshul du byon pa'i sgo nas legs par mnos te/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta zhes snyan par grags/ dgung lo nyer bdun pa la kha che paṇa chen gyi drung du bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ dgung lo so lnga'i bar du rje btsun rin po che'i zhabs pad bsten/ 'chi med dam chos kyi bdud rtsi spyi dang / khyad par du yo ga'i dbang rgyud lag len bshad pa sogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi ngom par gsol/ khyad par lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas phyi nang gi rten 'brel gyi gnad thams cad rang sar 'grig pa dang po'i yon tan mchog tu skyes te/ bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo 'jam dpal du mthong / shes bya'i gnas thams cad la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob/ nang du yang dag pa'i rtogs pa shar phyi rol tu lha 'dre mi gsum gyi 'gro ba thams cad dbang du 'dus/ rgya dkar nag la sogs pa'i rgyal po dregs myos kyi nga ro 'brug tu ldir ba mang pos kyang gsung gi bdud rtsi len par 'dod nas spyan 'dren gyi pho nya gtong ba sogs byung / dgung lo so brgyad pa tsam gyi tshe rgya bod kyi ngan rtog gi brag ri 'joms par byed pa'i tshad ma'i bstan bcos rigs gter brtsams/ lnga bcu rtsa gcig tsam gyi tshe legs bshad kyi sbrang rtsi spel ba'i dga' ston bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas par byed pa'i sdom gsum rab dbye bya ba'i nyi ma'i snang ba de nyid shar/ gzhan yang bstan bcos kyi tshogs mang du mdzad/ 'phags yul gyi gsung rab bsgyur pa la yang / yo ga rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dpal mchog dang cha mthun pa'i rgyud rdo rje snying po rgyan dang / sku gsung thugs gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa dang /

gsang ba nor bu'i thig le la sogs pa gsar 'gyur du mdzad de rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa la bka' drin mchog tu che zhing / gzhan yang tshad ma'i bstan bcos rnam 'grel dang phur ba rtsa dum la sogs pa rgyud dang bstan bcos mang po bsgyur bshad gtan la phab/ lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa'i tshe/ dbang phyug dang tshangs pa la skyabs su song zhing / drang srong ser skya dang gzeg zan la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa/ 'phrog byed dga' bo la sogs pa phyi rol pa'i ston pa drug gis chos rje pa'i snyan pa thos pas phrag dog gi bsam pa rlung ltar langs te rtsod par 'ongs pa na/ chos rje nyid 'phags pa wa ti'i dri'i gtsang khang dang 'dabs 'byor ba'i dpal gyi gnas su bzhugs pa dang mjal te/ phas kyi rgol ba ngan pa de dag re re nas lung rigs kyis tshar bcad de mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la bkod/ ral pa'i khur bregs nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bcug de lta bu'i grags dkar lha'i rnga bo che'i sgra gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir ma shong par rgya dkar nag dang hor bal gyi yul khams thams cad la khyab par byas/ de'i tshe sngon rje btsun rin po che sku gshegs khar khyod kyi tshe'i mjug tu zhwa khra 'dra/ l+h+wam phag sna 'dra ba gyon pa'i skad rigs mi gcig pa'i yul nas spyan 'dren pa 'ong bas de dus the tshom med par song shig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan pa'i 'gro don dpag med 'byung ngo zhes pa'i lung bstan gyi bdud rtsi stsal ba ltar/ dgung lo drug cu re gsum pa la/ stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba rgya nag mtha'i rgyal po go dan gyis bsod nams kyi mgron du spyan drangs te/ dbon po 'phags pa dang phyag na gnyis kyis zhabs 'bring byas te chas pa na/ bka' gdams pa nam mkha' 'bum gyis/ khyed la mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan ci mnga' ba zhig mi 'chab par snying gtam gyi tshul du gsung bar zhu/ gzhan yang khyed hor yul du byon pa hor 'di la khyed kyis phan pa'i rgyu mtshan e bdog

ces pa zhus pa'i lan du/ bdag sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mos gus phyin ci ma log pa yod/ gsung rab kyi don la go ba cung zad mchis/ mngon par rtogs pa rgyud la skyas pa tsam ni chen po mi bdog or 'dis nged la mchod gnas la cis kyang shog mi 'ongs na dmag 'ongs zer bas dmag byung na bod la gnod kyis dogs nas 'gro ba lags phan du re nas 'gro ba ma gtogs phan nges pa'i rgyu mtshan ma mchis/ lar sems can la phan na rang gi lus srog gtong ba la mi phod rgyu mi bdog pa tsam da lta shes pa la gda' zhes gsungs/ de nas drug cu rtsa lnga pa me pho stag gi lo pho brang chen po ling chu rtser gdan phebs/ der rgyal pos nyams sad pa'i phyir sgyu ma'i dri'i gtsang khang khang phran gyis bskor ba'i gtsug lag khang gi sgyu 'phrul gyi ra bar spyan drangs pa'i tshe/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus brtan par bzhugs su gsol te/ byang phyogs sprul pa sde'i lha khang zhes phyogs kun tu snyan pas khyab ste deng sang yang bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po go dan la sha khra'i nad drag po zhig byung ste/ de'i rim gror chab gtor 'jam dpal ma mang du mdzad pas/ sa bdag la shin tu phan pa zhig byung zhing / de'i dbang gis sa bdag de'i bran zhig mnal lam du byung nas/ go dan gyi nad 'di rgyu 'di lta bu zhig la brten nas byung bas/ sngar yang khyed sa skya pas nged klu la sman dang bza' rgyu byin pas phan par byung nga'i dpon de shi la khad yod/ de shi na go dan yang 'chi/ de gsos na go dan yang gsos pas/ khyed kyis nga'i dpon dang go dan gsos pa'i thabs la 'bad zer nas slar yang go dan gyi don du 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i cho ga mdzad pas rgyal po snyun las grol te shin tu dad par gyur to/ /de ltar dgung lo bdun cu ba'i bar du rgya nag gi yul du bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spel/ de nas smin drug zla ba'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin/

bi rdzi la nam mkhar ci 'dug gsungs/ ci yang mi gda' zhus pas/ thub pa nyan thos brgyad kyis bskor ba bzhugs 'dug gsungs/ bcu bzhi'i nyin kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gzigs/ bco lnga'i nyin 'jam dbyangs lan gsum dang / sgrol ma zhal gzigs/ zla ba de'i mar ngo la babs pa'i tshe bi rdzi la rol mo'i sgra thos sam/ ting nge 'dzin skyes sam mthong snang ci byung gsungs/ gzhan ci yang ma byung rol mo'i sgra thos zhus pas/ de yang sdig shas chung ba yin/ bde mchog la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor mang po 'dug gsungs/ de'i phyi nub kyi tho rangs dbus su rje btsun chen po/ g.yas su bir+wa pa/ g.yon du nag po pa gsum gyi zhal mngon sum du bstan nas/ khyod 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas lam la sbyangs shing skye ba nyi shu rtsa lngar mir gyur te 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung nas rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs pa yin/ khyad par skye ba 'di'i 'og rol tu mkha' la gnas pa'i rig pa 'dzin par gyur te sa lam phal cher bgrod/ skye ba gnyis pa la rgya gar shar phyogs mu mu ni zhes bya bar rgyal po nyi ma'i stobs 'phel gyi bur gyur nas bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rgyas par byas te skye ba gsum pa la mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba'i zhing du bde bar gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i dpal zhes bya bar 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur zhes lung bstan/ bir+wa pas mthun 'gyur dang / nag po pas rjes su yi rang mdzad/ de'i tshe bir+wa pas thod pa'i bdud rtsi nas ljags thog tu gtor bas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams bzang po rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs la'ang 'di las lhag pa med dam snyam pa 'khrungs shing / lcags phag smal zla'i yar tshes bcu bzhi'i tho rangs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas sku'i bkod pa re zhig bsdu bar mdzad do/ /chos rje de la slob ma'i tshogs shin tu mang yang grags che ba la/ rtogs pa'i brgyud 'dzin lho dmar rnam gnyis/

man ngag brgyud 'dzin tshogs grub dbon gsum/ bshad pa'i brgyud 'dzin shar nub gung gsum/ sdom phrug bsgres pa dpal bzang gi mtha' can bcu gsum/ gzhon pa rgyal mtshan gyi mtha' can brgyad/ skad gnyis smra ba bzhi/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po bzhi/ mkhas btsun gyi thugs sras bzhi/ bsgrub pa'i brgyud 'dzin rgyal ba yang dgon pa/ sbas pa'i grub chen zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan la sogs pa mang po byung ba yin no/ /de rnams kyi nang nas tshogs bsgom kun dga' dpal la/ bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas yo ga'i dbang rgyud bshad pa sogs sa lugs kyi gdams pa rnams phal cher yongs su rdzogs pa gnang / 'di nyid gtsang dge phur lcags pho rta la byon/ chos rje pa lo bcu gsum bsten/ dgung lo go brgyad pa la gshegs so/ /de nyid kyi drung du la nyan zhang gsum gyi nang nas nyan chen bsod nams brtan pas tshogs bsgom nyid lo bcu gsum bsten/ de'i ring la spyir gdam ngag mang du gsan/ khyad par yo ga la kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang sogs chos skor rdzogs par gsan cing spel nas/ dgung lo dgu bcu go drug bzhugs so/ /yang tshogs grub dbon gsum gyi nang nas dbon po 'phags pa rin po che ni/ shing mo lug lo ngam ring klu khung du byon/ dgung lo gsum bzhes pa'i tshe sgrub thabs mtsho skyes la mkhas pa du ma'i dbus su bshad pa mdzad/ drug pa la chos rje sa paṇa gyi phyag phyir skyid grong du byon/ bcu pa la gcung phyag na dang bcas chos rje'i zhabs phyir hor yul la byon pa'i lam bar dbus su chos rje sa paṇa gyis mkhan po/ zul phu bas slob dpon mdzad de rab tu byung / snga phyir chos rje pa sogs bla ma rnams las mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i chos tshul spyi dang bye brag yo ga'i skor rnams mthar phyin par gsan/ bcu gnyis pa la hor rgyal po'i pho brang chen por phebs/ bcu bdun pa la lung rtogs kyi yon tan phul du phyin pas bstan pa'i khur 'dzin bzod par dgongs nas/

chos kyi rjes chos dung dang lhung bzed la sogs pa gnang bstan pa gtad/ bco brgyad pa la chos rje'i gshegs rdzongs rnams legs par bsgrubs/ bcu dgu pa la hor rgyal po se chen gan gyis spyan drangs rgyal pos dka' gnas mang po dris pa'i lan rgyu mtshan dang bcas gsungs pas mnyes te/ rgyal pos zhus pa'i ngor rgyal pos gtsos pa'i skal ldan du ma la snga phyir dges pa rdo rje'i dbang lan gsum gnang ba'i dbang yon dang po la dbus gtsang khri skor bcu gsum/ bar pa la chol kha gsum/ tha ma la bla ma nyid kyis bka' gnang ste rgya'i mi yur chen mo phul/ ti shrī'i mtshan gsol/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa la rgya hor gyi mtshams su mkhan po snye thang pa grags pa seng ge las slob jo gdan bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ gsang ston yar lung pa byang chub rgyal mtshan sogs las bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan slob de dag sogs lnga phyir mkhas grub dpag tu med pa bsten nas sngar ma gsan pa'i mdo sngags kyi chos mtha' yas pa gsan/ dgung lo nyer gsum pa la sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu gsum gyi mtshan mo chos rje pa gsal bar byon nas chos kyi gnad du ma gsungs/ khyod 'di nas bzung ste lo 'bum phrag gcig dang stong 'das pa na phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan cing dbugs dbyung / de'i tshe 'phags pa rin po ches/ srid par du khaḥdu ma yis/ /yun ring dus su dub pa bdag /legs par gsungs pas dbugs 'byin pa/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug mkhyen pa'i gtso/ /chos kyi rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bstod pa mdzad/ slar so gcig pa la dpal ldan sa skyar phebs/ dbus gtsang gi skye dgu thams cad chos dang zang zing gi bde ba la bkod/ so gsum pa la las tshan bcu gsum gyi bkod pa mdzad de/ slar yang shar phyogs su byon/ bcom ldan rig ral gyis/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bka' chag sprin gyis sgrib/ /ces sogs zur za'i zhu mchid phul/

bstan la 'phel 'grib 'byung ba rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes sogs kyi lan gsungs/ so bzhi pa la rgyal po'i pho brang du phebs/ dpon chen shākya bzang pos lha khang chen mo'i gzhi bting / slar zhe gcig pa la dpal ldan sa skyar phebs/ zhe gsum pa la gtsang chu mig ring mor dge 'dun khri phrag bdun la chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor/ mdor na dgung lo zhe drug gi bar du 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs bstan pa'i bya ba rgyud ma chad par mdzad kyang / nang du ting nge 'dzin las cung zad kyang mi g.yel bas yi dam gyi lha dpag tu med pa'i zhal gzigs 'od gsal rgyun mi chad/ mngon par shes pa thogs med mnga' ba yin te mtshon pa tsam du/ skyid grong du byon pa'i tshe spyan ras gzigs mnal lam du zhal gzigs pa dang / chos rje yang dgon pas chos rje rgya nag la 'byon par gda' na/ nged rnams phyag sogs byed pa'i 'os su sku tshab cig 'tshal bas dbon po 'di dag yang dag lags sam zhus pas/ dbon po rnal ma lags gsungs/ bla ma 'di spyan ma btsum par mnal du song ba bstan nas 'di 'od gsal zin pa'i rtags lags/ nged kyi mi brgyud rnal ma la 'od gsal cung zad re rgyun mi 'chad du 'ong ba yin gsungs pa dang / bla ma 'di rgya nag nas dbus gtsang du phebs skabs shig 'u yug tu bzhugs pa'i tshe lha bu nas jo gdan zhig zhu don gcod du phyin pas sgar chen po'i mtha' na sems can la gnod pa skyel ba sogs mthong bas shin tu ma dad pa byung / drung du mjal ba na/ g.yas phyogs su rtsom yig pa mang po la gsung rab kyi rtsom spor/ g.yon phyogs su chab shog 'bri mi mang po la 'jig rten gyi zhal bkod spor/ mdun du ban chung zhig gis gtor skad dang bcas gtor ma bsham pa bsngo ba bzhin ni mi 'dug pas shin tu yid ma rangs te/ g.yon gyi chab shog ni nga zhu ba la yong ba dang 'dra gzhan mnar ba'i ched kho na yin/ g.yas kyi rtsom yang ci 'dra yod mi shes/

bsngo mkhan med pa'i gtor ma bshams nas ci byed snyam khong rang gis bsngos te tshar ba na/ bla ma'i gsung las/ gtor ma bshams pas tshim pa de kho bos byas/ bsngos pas tshim pa de khyod kyis byas/ ting nge 'dzin gyis tshim pa de ngas byas ang gsungs byung bas/ mngon shes thogs med mnga' bar shes te shin tu dad par gyur nas/ phyogs thams cad du snyan pa'i grags pa bsgrags pa sogs byung ba 'di dag mtshon no/ /yang rtsod pa'i sgo nas zin shing gi ston pa rang gi gzhung lugs la ring du sbyangs shing mthar son pa/ lta ba phyin ci log la zhugs pa bcu bdun lung rigs kyis sun phyung ste/ yang dag pa'i lta ba 'dzin du bcug pa dang / tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i sgo nas nyid dang nyid kyi dngos kyi slob ma dang bcas pas dge slong dang dge tshul bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig gis mkhan po mdzad de/ rgya nag dang rgya nag chen po'i yul khams ngur smrig 'dzin pas khyab par mdzad de sngon med pa'i sa phyogs thams cad dam pa'i chos la bkod do/ /de dag la sogs pa rnam dkar gyi mdzad pas thugs rangs par gyur te/ zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i 'dun pa na/ dpal gyi ri la 'phags pa klu sgrub byang chub kyi shing drung na bzhugs pa la dbu ma rigs tshogs sogs theg chen gyi chos mang du gsan cing / de'i tshe lha mang pos mchod pa byed pa dang / rigs sngags kyi rgyal po rma bya chen mo yang gsal bar gzigs pa'i snang ba byung bsogs ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa mang du bstan nas dgung lo zhe drug pa la zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan to/ /'di la slob ma'i mchog man ngag gi bka' babs zhang dkon mchog dpal dang / dge slong kun blo gnyis/ rgyud kyi bka' babs dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal dang / dga' ldan pa kun bsod gnyis/ mgon po'i bka' babs dam pa kun dga' grags/ mnyes pa'i mchod g.yog ti shrī grags 'od/ bla chen sangs rgyas sras/ ri phug pa dar ma rgyal mtshan/

spro lung pa kun smon dang bzhi/ nus pa'i bdag nyid gcung phyag na dang / rgyal po jin gim gnyis so/ /gzhan yang shar pa dus 'khor ba ye shes rin chen/ shar pa kun dga' seng ge shar pa 'jam dbyangs/ bzhi thog pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ khang gsar ba ti shrī sangs rgyas dpal/ gnyan tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ cha gan dbang phyug rgyal mtshan te che ba'i bdag nyid drug la sogs dang / mdor na de dus kyi kha ba can pa'i bla dpon sogs skye bo yod do cog ji snyed pa de nyid kyis bla chen 'di'i zhabs spyi bor blangs shing gsung gi bdud rtsi len par mdzad pa yin no/ /de ltar bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i thugs sras tshogs grub dbon gsum gyi brgyud pa'i bka' babs 'dzin pa la la nyan zhang gsum du grags pa'i nyan chen pa la bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal gyi sras kyi thu bo ti shrī kun dga' blo gros kyis spyir gdams pa mang po dang / bye brag kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang 'di nyid sogs yo ga'i chos skor mang po gsan nas rang gi gcung bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la gnang / de nas bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan rnams brgyud de snyigs dus kyi rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po la sa skya pa'i yab chos spyi dang / khyad par rnal 'byor rgyud kyi chos skor rnams bka' babs/ dam pa 'dis kun rig sa lugs kyi bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i yig cha sgrib pa rnam sel/ ras bris la brten pa'i cho ga'i rnam gzhag gzhan phan mtha' yas/ de nyid rdul tshon dang sbyar ba'i rdul tshon kha skongs/ de gnyis ka la dgos pa'i cha gsum gtor ma da nga / gzhan yang kun rig gi bstod chen gyi phyag rgya 'cha' tshul gyi yi ge gu ge tho ling gser gyi lha khang na lo chen rin chen bzang pos bzhengs pa'i kun rig lha tshogs kyi bzhugs tshul dang / phyag mtshan gyi 'dzin lugs la gzigs nas/

de'i don tshigs bcad du bsdebs par mdzad pa rnams mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rjes zin bris su btab pa'i phyis dpe de'i mjug shog 'khyar nas/ rdo rje gar ma man ma tshang ba'i kha skong rnams bla ma gong ma dag gi gsung rgyun phyag len bzhin byas 'gyur ba bsod nams seng ges kha bskangs pa la sogs mang du yod cing / phyag len gyi cha la nye bar mkho ba'i sku dngos dang brgyud pas spel ba'i gsung rab/ gzhan yang rje rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyis yo ga rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la 'chad nyan mang du mdzad skabs kyi gsung la zin bris mdzad pa'i bstan bcos kyang shin tu mang ste/ dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i yo ga'i spyi bshad kyi zin bris/ srad pa kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i yo ga'i spyi rnam dang / sbyong rgyud la bdag chen chu mig pas rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun bris pa'i sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi spyi don/ gung ru shes rab bzang pos mdzad pa'i kun rig gi rnam bshad yid kyi mun sel ces bya ba'i zin bris rnams dang / gzhan yang mnga' ris pa tshul 'od kyis mdzad pa'i sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi cho ga'i rnam gzhag gzhan phan lhun grub la sogs dngos slob dang yang slob rnams kyis mdzad pa'i yo ga'i chos skor ngo mtshar can mang du 'byung ba yin no/ /de ltar rgyal bas lung bstan brnyes pa'i rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos/ spyir slob ma'i mchog ches mang zhing yo ga'i bka' srol 'dzin pa yang mang du byung ba las/ thugs kyi sras mchog dam pa ni mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan te/ dam pa 'dis rje kun dga' bzang po 'di la spyir rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos gsung ngag rin po che'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa cha lag dang bcas pa dang / 'khor lo bde mchog gi skor sogs sa skya pa'i gdams pa zab dgu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsan cing /

khyad par yo ga la kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang sogs dang / sbyong rgyud kyi bshad bka' la sogs pa yo ga'i chos skor mang po gsan nas kun rig gi cho ga'i yig cha yang mdzad/ de da lta bka' 'bum gyi khrod na bzhugs pa'i ngo mtshar can 'di yin zhing / mus chen sems dpa' chen po de nyid kyi drung du kun mkhyen chen po bsod nams seng ges spyir rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dbang bka' bshad bka' lung bka' sogs dpag par dka' ba zhig gsan nas thugs rgyud yongs su gtams par mdzad cing / khyad par yo ga la kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang sogs chos skor rnams cha tshang bar gsan te/ sbyong rgyud kyi rnam bshad gzhan phan kun khyab/ gzhan phan 'od zer la rtsod spong gzhan phan gnod 'joms sogs mdzad de rje btsun gyi dgongs pa sbyong rgyud dang mthun par bsgrub par mdzad do/ /de lta bu'i rtsod spong mdzad dus mnal lam du mtha' ne'u sing gis bskor ba zhig tu grwa pa mang pos khri mthon po zhig rtsig gin 'dug pa la/ su'i yin dris pas rje mus pa chen po sbyong rgyud gsung ba'i khri yin zer/ rje 'dis kyang las grogs mdzad pas de ma thag grub nas khri dkar la mtho ba zhig gi steng du rje sems dpa' chen po byon pas/ da lta bod na sbyong rgyud la nga las mkhas pa med pas nyan mkhan yod na shog cig gsungs pa sogs zhal pho du ma dang bcas sbyong rgyud kyi bshad pa zhib la mtha' chod par mdzad kyin 'dug sngar yin na zhal pho mdzad pa'i lugs mi 'dug pa da lam ci yin nam snyam bsgrims te gsan pas/ ji lta ba bzhin thugs su chud pa rmis/ mnal sad pa na tshig ris shog ldeb gcig tsam thugs la gsal bar 'dug pas kun rig rtsod spong gi nang du bris shing / sngar ma go ba'i dka' gnas mang po yang go bas rtsom de'i mjug tu/ rmi lam ri rtser zab don rnyed pa yis/ /rtags dang mtshan ma'i nyid 'od lham mer gsal/

/zhes 'bri bar mdzad pa yin no zhes grags so/ /kun mkhyen nyid kyi drung du 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyis gsan/ de nas mkhan chen nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rje chos dbang phyug sogs rim par brgyud de bla ma phyi ma de dag las bdag cag lha dang bcas pa'i 'dren pa dam pa dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i rje btsun bud+dha'i mtshan can gyis yo ga'i dbang rgyud bshad sogs chos skor rdzogs par gsan te yang nas yang du spel bar mdzad cing / khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi drung du kho bo cag gis mnos pa yin te/ de yang ngos cag rang lo bcu bdun lon pa'i glang gi lo rje btsun mus pa chen po nyid kyi zhabs drung du slebs pa'i phyi lo rje nyid dgung lo bdun cu don gsum bzhes pa'i tshe/ gling dga' bde ba can gyi chos ra zur gyi gnas mchog de nyid du spyir zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu'i bka' drin mnos shing / bye brag rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dbang bshad lung khrid sogs stsal ba'i tshe rje bla ma bka' drin can de nyid zhal gyi dkyil 'khor zla ba rgyas pa lta bu 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan bzhin pa'i ngang nas gsung gi nga ro sbom zhing zil che ba snyan pas chos thun rnams rim par stsol par mdzad cing / sku cha byad mdzes shing lhun chags la gzi 'od 'bar ba mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa dbang med du bskyed pa de nyid bdag sogs slob tshogs kyi dbus su lham me ba dang bcas/ thugs ting nge 'dzin bzang po'i rgyun la g.yo ba med pa'i rtags su chos gsung pa'i bar skabs dag tu yang skabs 'gar ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun la lhan ne bzhugs pa sogs rje bla ma de nyid kyi rnam thar gang la bsams kyang / bla ma sangs rgyas mi gzugs can 'di lta bu dang mjal ba skal ba bzang snyam pa'i shes pa spro sing nge ba dang bcas thog mar sbyong rgyud bshad pa'i kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang rje btsun sa skya pa nas brgyud pa de nyid dang /

lo chen rin bzang gi slob ma snyal pa nyi ma shes rab/ de'i slob ma snor nyi ma 'od zer sogs nas brgyud pa'i sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang rnams rim par stsal ba'i bar skabs rnams su rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i sbyong rgyud sa bcad dang mchan bu gnyis/ cho ga'i rnam gzhag ston pa gzhan phan 'od zer/ 'chad thabs kyi man ngag ston pa gzhan phan spyi 'ching / lag len gyi rnam bzhag ston pa gzhan phan nyer mkho ste gzhan phan skor gsum mam lngar grags pa rnams dang / kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa'i sbyong rgyud kyi 'grel pa gzhan phan kun khyab/ gzhan gyi rtsod pa spong ba gzhan phan gnod 'joms gnyis/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug pa'i gsung la rje zhe dgon pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / rje btsun dam pa chos dbang phyug gnyis kyis zin bris su mdzad pa'i kun rig gi cho ga'i rnam bshad chen mo dpag bsam ljon pa sogs kyi lung dang bshad pa/ dka' gnas kyi dogs dpyod phyag rgya sogs phyag len phra mo tshun chad kyi brda' sbyor dang bcas/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi gzhan phan mtha' yas sogs gsung rab rnams dang sbyor bar mdzad nas mtha' chod par stsol bar mdzad cing / lhag par sbyong rgyud mchan bu dang bcas pa'i lung bshad gnang ba'i dus su sku tshe hril bor yo ga rnal 'byor rgyud kho na la sbyong bar mdzad pa lta bu'i sngar gangs can gyi khrod 'dir mkhas pa gzhan gyi blo ngor ma shar ba'i legs bshad ngo mtshar can mu mtha' med pa zhig spro bar mdzad de/ der skabs kyi chos thun rnams kyang shin tu che ba byung ba yin no/ /de ltar gong du bkod pa'i gsung rab de rnams kyi lung dang bshad pa mtha' dag ni/ slar yang rje bla ma de nyid kyi dngos kyi slob ma brgyud ldan yid tshe can rnams las kyang nan tan du mnos nas khongs su tshud par bgyis te/ da ni skal bzang dad ldan rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su rnal 'byor yo ga'i chos kyi dga' ston gang la ci 'dod kyi tshul du lan brgyar spel bar 'dod pa la spro ba mchog tu gyur pa 'di lags/

yang gong du smos pa'i bla ma brgyud pa de dag gi nang nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi drung du sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub gnyis kyis kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor sa lugs kyi dbang dang / sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis so so'i dbang dang bcas pa gsan cing / sa lo 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid dang rje dkon mchog lhun grub gnyis ka las/ snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po sprul pa'i skyes mchog sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis yo ga'i chos skor rnams gsan par mdzad de/ skyes chen dam pa de nyid kyis dpal ldan sa skyar mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i me ro mtha' dag rmang nas bslangs te/ gsang sngags zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mang po'i sgrub mchod gzhan rnams gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa dang dus mnyam du rang gi yum ma cig bu 'dren skyid kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su lo dus kyi kun rig gi sgrub mchod zhag grangs du ma'i bar du bsgrub par mdzad cing / sa skya tshogs chen du yang dril thogs chen mor grags pa'i chog grwa bzang po'i rgyun spel bar mdzad pa sogs da lta'i bar du ma nyams par bzhugs pa 'di yin zhing / yang 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi drung du mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtshos kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang dang / bla ma gzhan las kyang mnos pa'i sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi dbang sogs yang yang spel bar mdzad pa las/ bdag gi bla ma 'jam dbyangs grub pa'i khyu mchog bsod nams dbang po dang / yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros mched gnyis kyis kyang kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho las gsan par mdzad cing / bdag gis kyang grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan can gyi drung du kun rig gi cho ga gzhan phan mtha' yas dang / de dang 'brel ba'i rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i lugs 'di'i gsung rab 'ga' zhig gi lung gi bka' drin mnos shing /

rgyal sras grags pa'i mtshan can las kyang cho ga spyi dang / bye brag byang bu bsreg pa'i lho sgo'i cho ga'i phyag len sogs mig gi bdud rtsir yang yang stsol bar mdzad pa yin la/ yang kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang gi brgyud pa kha che lugs ni/ rdor sems pa nu pa ma rak+ṣi ta/ /shin+ti pa dang 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas/ /rdo rje gdan pa bik+ṣa ta de wa/ /shākya shrī dang bi bhu ta tsan+d+ra/ /g.yag sde lo tsā zhang ston dkon mchog dpal/ /brag phug pa dang blo brtan pa man 'dra/ /zhes pa ltar yin la/ yang kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor chag lo lugs kyi dbang brgyud ni/ kun rig kun dga' snying po rab 'byor bskyangs/ /shan+ti pa dang rdo rje gdan pa che/ /'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas dang dzñā na shrī/ /rnyog med lha dang rdo rje gdan pa chung ba/ dang / /ra wan+t+ra dang chos rje dpal/ chag lo g.yag sde lo tsā ba/ ba/ /paṇ+ḍi ta/ rdo rje shes rab dkon mchog dpal man 'dra/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de dag ni yo ga'i chos skor spyi dang bye brag kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang gi brgyud pa rnams gtso bor smos pa yin la/ da ni sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po so so'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi mtshan rtogs sla ba'i phyir lhan cig tu brjod na/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ bram ze dzi na mi tra/ swasti pha la/ sgra gcan zin/ pra dzñā wa li ta/ shes rab bskyangs/ ye shes rdo rje/ pra hi ta/ rab tu phan pa/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po/ rab 'byor bskyangs/ dharma pha la/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ snyal pa skabs 'dir gsan yig phal cher las lo chen gyi rjes su snyal pa 'byung ba bzhin bris pa yin la/ spyir rje btsun gyi rdo rje 'byung ba'i ṭik+kar/ snyal pas kha che dzñā na shrī dang / zangs dkar/ mang nang pa/ sgyi nor dzñā na rnams las yo ga gsan par bshad kyi/

lo chen las gsan par ma bshad pas/ lo chen gyi rjes su/ mang nang gi gur shing brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ de nas snyal pa nyi ma shes rab ces lo chen dang snyal pa'i bar du mang nang pa bgrang dgos snyam ste dpyad par bya'o/ nyi ma shes rab/ snur nyi ma 'od zer/ gshen rdo rje seng ge rgya gsar pa/ 'bro dzi ti pa/ snye mdo ba bsod nams dpal/ snyal pa chos grags/ bya rin chen 'od/ blo chen sangs rgyas sras/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul rgyal ba/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ rje kun dga' bzang po/ kha char ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ byang chub blo gros rin chen/ mkhan chen dkon mchog rin chen 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhan dkon mchog rin chen/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ de'i drung du sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams bdag gis dad 'dun chen po'i sgo nas mnos pa lags/ yang 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi drung / sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho gsum kas gsan zhing / sa lo/ lo chen gnyis ka'i drung du/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis gsan par mdzad la/ yang brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ 'dzim pa blo chen yan gong dang 'dra ba las/ de nas lo mchog bla ma bsod dbang / kun mkhyen seng ge 'bum/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rje rdo rje 'chang man sngar dang 'dra la/ yang ngor chen kun bzang gi rjes su/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ chos rje mgon po dbang phyug gnyan lo grags pa blo gros/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho yan sngar dang 'dra ba dang / yang na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / mkhas grub dpal rdor ba/ rwa chen yon tan dpal bzang / 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' brtan pa/
