dge legs bshes gnyen/ rje shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / de'i drung du bdag gi bla ma yab rje sbas ba'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyis gsan zhing / de dus kho bo cag kyang lo shin tu gzhon nu'i dus yin pas/ sta gon dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig gnyis shig gi dbang tsam zhig thob bo zhes bka' drin can gyi yab rje chos kyi rgyal po nyid kyi gsung las thos so/ /de ltar de dag gis ni rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam pa'i chos 'byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa yo ga chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba mdo tsam bshad pa bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ /'og min gnas dang ri rab lhun po'i rtser/ /rnam snang longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa yis/ /rgyud rgyal gsungs pa'i ston dang bstan pa dang / /'khor dang bsdud par mdzad rnams bsngags par 'os/ /za hor grong khyer chen po'i rgyal khams su/ /gsang bdag dbang pos rdor dbyings dkyil 'khor che/ /sprul nas dbang bskur zab mo'i rgyud gtad pa'i/ /mi bdag rab gsal zla bar snying nas dad/ /'phags yul yo ga'i srol 'byed rnams kyi gtso/ /kun dga' snying po sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / /shākya bshes gnyen zhes su yongs grags pa'i/ /mkhas pa mi gsum brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir bstan pa phyi dar dus/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal khu dbon rim byon pa'i/ /bstan 'gro'i phyir du sku srog gtong ba la/ /zhum med rgyal sras che rnams phyag gi gnas/ /dus der skad gnyis smra ba'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /skyes mchog lo chen rin chen bzang po yis/ /dam chos spyi dang khyad par yo ga yi/ /zab rgyas chos tshul rgya mtsho bod 'dir bsgyur/ /mgon de'i sku tshe'i stod dang smad kyi char/ /bstan 'dzin slob tshogs bskrun pa de rnams kyis/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa mnga' ris dang /

/dbus gtsang ljongs 'dir spel ba'i srol gnyis dang / /de ltar yo ga stod lugs smad lugs sogs/ /mdo sngags rig gnas dag gis legs bsdus pa'i/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa/ /bla chen brgyud par bcas rnams spyi bos mchod/ /de ltar sa skya'i rje btsun bzhed pa'i srol/ /skyong mdzad bstan 'dzin rim par byon rnams dang / /'gran bral ngor chen mus chen kun mkhyen rje/ /slob mar bcas pa'i bka' drin bsam las 'das/ /gzhan yang sngon gyi rtsa snur 'dzim gsum dang / /phyis byon bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa sogs/ /gangs ljongs yo ga'i bstan 'dzin mchog rnams la/ /blo ldan su zhig gus pa lhur mi byed/ /khyad par snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma che/ /sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras dang / /rgyal kun spro bsdu'i byed po mus chen rjer/ /gsol 'debs slar yang byang chub bar du skyongs/ /de ltar rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam pa'i chos/ /byung tshul legs par bshad pa'i ngo mtshar gtam/ /yo ga chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed 'di/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i lhag bsam gyis/ /sngon byon gong ma'i gsung rab rgya mtsho las/ /rab gsal blo yis legs par bsdus te sbyar/ /dge ba 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag dang bdag gi gdul byar gyur pa yi/ /shes rgyud sgrib gnyis bag chags kun byang nas/ /dus 'dir nad med tshe rabs mthar phyin zhing / /rdo rje'i lus brtas dbang po kun gsal bas/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don mang 'grub pa dang / /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /dpon slob lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /sa lam mthar phyin gang 'dul sprul pa yis/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rgyas byed shog /gzhan yang gangs ri'i khrod kyi rdo rje gdan/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i bstan pa'i rgyun skyong ba'i/ /myur du rigs brgyud dri med 'ga' 'byung zhing / /de rgyun bskal par rgyun chad med par shog

/de dag rnams dang dngos brgyud slob ma yi/ /sngags 'chang yab sras bstan pa'i rgyun bzang 'di/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rab rgyas nas/ /bdag gi re smon thams cad 'grub gyur cig /ces rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa yo ga chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di yang / 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul bsod nams dbang po dang / byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba mtsho'i rnam par sprul pa sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' nyid gzhan ngor ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sprul pa'i sku lo nas spyan snga rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can/ rje nags dgon pa chen po sbyin pa grags pa/ nyams rtogs kyi mnga' bdag grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa/ dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sngon byon pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyis rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i tshul gyi gsung rab rnams mthong ba'i tshe/ dang 'dod kyi dad pa bcos ma ma yin pa skyes pas rkyen byas/ da dung bdag la brten nas rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa cung zad tsam 'phel na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas bslangs te/ rgya gar lugs la i shwa raḥste dbang phyug ces grags shing / rgya nag lugs la me mo glang gi lo nag pa zla ba'i dmar cha dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i bzhi thog bla brang gi tshoms dmar du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rang dang nye bar gnas pa'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa gsung rab kyi blo mig gsal ba'i rab 'byams smra ba bsam gtan rgya mtshos dad pa dang brtson 'grus bla na med pa'i sgo nas mgyogs par bgyis so/

/'dis bstan pa spyi dang bye brag rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa 'phel zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/ skye dgu rnams dge bar gyur cig dharme u da ya mastu/ chos 'di dar bar gyur cig/ // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
